sa: क्षमाशीला पुरा भूत्वा साद्य न क्षमसे कथम्। अधर्मं जहि धर्मज्ञे यतो धर्मस्ततो जयः॥
en: You formerly observed the virtue of forgiveness. Why would you not observe it now? Restrain unrighteousness, O you who are ever righteousness. There is victory where righteousness is.

sa: अयं च वीर संदेहस्तिष्ठतीव ममाग्रतः। सुमहत्सु सहायेषु हर्युक्षेषु महाबलः॥ कथं नु खलु दुष्पारं संतरिष्यति सागरम्। तानि हयृक्षसैन्यानि तौ वा नरवरात्मजौ॥
en: O hero, this mighty doubt is (ever) present before me. How shall that exceedingly powerful one or that host of monkeys or those two sons of that man of men, albeit backed by mighty monkeys, cross over the ocean incapable of being crossed?

sa: मया हते संयति कुम्भकर्णे महाबले मुष्टिविशीर्णदेहे। विमोचिते वानरपार्थिवे च भवन्तु हृष्टाः प्लवगाः समग्राः॥
en: Let me kill the mighty Kumbhakarņa, splitting his body with my strong fist and thus relive the master of monkeys—thus let the whole host of monkeys become delighted.

sa: यथा हि सुकृलभे क्षेत्रे फलं विन्दति मानवः। एवं दत्त्वा श्रुतवति फलं दाता समश्नुते॥
en: Men, when they sow on a wellcultivated field reap an abundant harvest. Even so one reaps great merit by making gifts to a Brahmana endued with great learning.

sa: ते भक्ष्यमाणा हरयो रामं जग्मुस्तदा गतिम्। कुम्भकर्णो भृशं क्रुद्धः कपीन्खादन्प्रधावति॥ शतानि सप्त चाष्टौ च विंशत्रिंशतथैव च। संपरिष्वज्य बाहुभ्यां खादन्विपरिधावति ॥
en: The monkeys as they were being devoured, saught the shelter of Rāma. And Kumbhakarna wrought up with wrath, chased a main hundreds of monkeys, eating up seven, eight, twenty, or thirty. And fastening (the monkeys) with his arms, he, devouring them, rushed on.

sa: संजय उवाच ते सेने शिबिरं गत्वा न्यविशेतां विशाम्पते। यथाभागं यथान्यायं यथागुल्मं च सर्वशः॥
en: Sanjaya said O lord of men, the troops having retired to their camps, duly took up their quarters, according to the divisions and ranks to which they belonged.

sa: यदि दृश्येत सा साध्वी यदि चेह वसेमहि। स्पृहयेयं न शक्राय नायोध्यायै रघूत्तम ॥
en: O best of Raghus, I do not desire Ayodhyā or the dignity of Indra if that chaste Sītā be found here and if I can live with her.

sa: स तच्छरीरं संत्यज्य प्रविवेश धरां तदा। भूमिं स्पृष्टासृजद् धातून पृथक् पृथगतीव हि॥ पूयात् स गन्धं तेजश्च अस्थिभ्यो देवदारु च। श्लेष्मणः स्फाटिकं तस्य पित्तान्मारकतं तथा॥ यकृत् कृष्णायसं तस्य त्रिभिरेव वभुः प्रजाः। नखास्तस्याभ्रपटलं शिराजलानि विदुमम्॥
en: Leaving his material body, he entered into the nether world. Coming in contact with the earth, he created different force and perfume arose from his puss, the Deodar tree from his bones, grass from this phlegm, the Marakata jewel from his bile and the black iron from his liver. All the worlds have been established with these three substances. The clouds were made from his nails and corals from his arteries,

sa: आहूय कश्यपं देव इदं वचनमब्रवीत्। यदेते दन्दशूकाश्च सर्पा जातस्त्वयानघ॥ विषोल्बणा महाभोगा मात्रा शप्ताः परंतप। तत्र मन्युस्त्वया तात न कर्तव्यः कथंचन॥
en: Then calling Kashyapa, the Deity said. “O sinless one, O powerful one, the snakes of virulent poison, of huge bodies and of biting propensity whom you have begotten have been cursed by their mother. O child, you should not be angry with her.

sa: का त्वं कस्यासि कल्याणि कुतो वा त्वं वरानने। प्राप्ता विराटनगरं तत् त्वमाचक्ष्व शोभने।॥
en: Who and whose are you, O graceful one? Whence are you come to this city of Virata, O you of beautiful countenance. Tell me truly, O fair one.

sa: स शत्रुनिहतः संख्ये मया धर्मेण पाण्डव। यथा त्वया हतः शूरो भगदत्तः पित्तुः सखा॥
en: O son of Pandu, Drona was my enemy; and therefore it is righteous that I have slain him; and thus you have slain your father's friend, king Bhagadatta.

sa: प्रतिगृह्य च तां कन्यां भगवान् प्रससाद ह। प्राप्त प्रसादो राजा वै ससैन्यः पुरमाव्रजत्॥
en: Having received that maiden, the exalted one was pleased (with the king). Having obtained the Rishi's grace, the king with his soldiers then went to his own city.

sa: भीष्मो द्रोणः कृपः कर्णः शकुनिः सह राजभिः। संग्रामस्थस्य ते पुत्र कलां नार्हन्ति षोडशीम्॥
en: O son, when you will be engaged in battle, Bhishma, Drona, Kripa, Karma, Shakuni, together with (other) kings, shall not approach (in strength) a sixteenth part of yours."

sa: त्वं समर्थतरः पित्रा युद्धे तारेय वै ध्रुवम्। दृढं धारयितुं शक्तः कपिराज्यं यथा पिता॥
en: O Tārā's son, you are for certain more capable of fight than even your sire; and you are also able to hold the monkey-kingdom as firmly as he.

sa: तिष्ठ तिष्ठ न मे जीवन् द्रोणपुत्र गमिष्यसि। एष त्वां निहनिष्यामि महिषं षण्मुखो यथा॥
en: “Wait, wait. O son of Drona, you shall not escape alive. I will presently destroy you as the six-faced (Kartikeya) slew the (Asura) Mahisha in days of yore).

sa: याचितोऽसि पुरा राजन् दाशार्हेण शमं प्रति। न च तं लब्धवान् कामं त्वत्तः कृष्णोमहायशाः॥
en: O king, the descendant of the Dasarha race entreated you for the conclusion of peace. But the highly-renowned Krishna then did not obtain that boon at your hands.

sa: भीष्म उवाच ब्राह्मणा ब्राह्मणस्येह भोज्या ये चैव क्षत्रियाः। वैश्याश्चापि तथा भोज्याः शूद्राश्च परिवर्जिताः॥
en: Bhishma said A Brahmana may take his food from another Brahmana or from a Kshatriya or from a Vaishya but he must never take food from a Shudra.

sa: लङ्कायां तु कृतं कर्म घोरं दृष्ट्वा भयावहम्। राक्षसेन्द्रो हनुमता शक्रेणेव महात्मना। अब्रवीद्राक्षसान्सर्वान्हिया किंचिदवाङ्मुखः॥
en: Beholding in Lankā that dreadful and aweinspiring work performed by Hanuman like to the high-souled Sakra, the lord of Raksasas, looking down with shame, addressed them all, saying.

sa: उपस्थापय मे क्षिप्रं रथं सौम्य धनूंषि च। शरांश्च चित्रान् खङ्गांश्च शक्तीश्च विविधाः शिताः॥
en: And you gentle one, do you at once bring my car as well as my bows, and pasty coloured arrows and scimitars, and darts, and various whetted javelins.

sa: दुःखानि च बहूनीह अनुभूतानि पार्थिव। शयानो दुःखशय्यासु नन्दिग्रामे महायशाः॥ फलमूलाशनो भूत्वा जटी चीरधरस्तथा।
en: Undergoing many a hardship, o king, that illustrious one passed his days, lying down on a bed of sorrow, and living on fruits and roots, and wearing rags.

sa: अभिषेकं कुमारस्य दैत्यानां च वधं तथा। श्रुत्वा मे परमा प्रीतिर्भूयः कौतूहलं हि मे॥
en: Having heard the history of the installation of Kumara and the destruction of the Daityas, I have been greatly pleased, I feel a curiosity, however, regarding another subject.

sa: तं दृष्ट्वा परमं हर्षे सुदेवतनयो ययौ। मेने च मनसा दग्धान् वैतहव्यान् स पार्थिवः॥
en: Seeing the prince, the son of Sudeva, viz., king Divodasa become filled with joy. Indeed, the old king thought the sons of his enemy Vitahavya as already killed.

sa: सब्रह्मकेषु लोकेषु सप्तस्वष्यखिलेषु च। न तद्भूतमहं मन्ये यदर्कादतिरिच्यते॥ सन्ति चान्यानि सत्त्वानि वीर्यवन्ति महान्ति च। न त तेषां तथा दीप्तिः प्रभावो वा यथा तव॥ ज्योतीषिं त्वयि सर्वाणि त्वं सर्वज्योतिषां पतिः। त्वयि सत्यं च सत्त्वं च सर्वे भावाश्च सात्त्विका:।४७॥ त्वत्तेजसा कृतं चक्रं सुनाभं विश्वकर्मणा। देवारीणां मदो येन नाशितः शार्ङ्गधन्वना॥
en: There is nothing that I know in the whole of the seven worlds including that of Brahma which is beyond you. There are other beings both powerful and great, but none of them possesses lustre and prowess as you do. All light is in you. You are the lord of all light. In you are the elements, you are knowledge and you are all the ascetic properties. The discuss, by which the wielder of the Saranga (the bow of Vishnu) humble the pride of the Asuras and which is furnished with a beautiful have, was made by Vishvakarma with your effulgence.

sa: सखा च ते भविष्यामि मत्समो नास्ति पन्नगः। लघुश्च ते भविष्यामि शीघ्रमादाय गच्छ माम्॥
en: I have not a peer among the snakes; I will be your companion. I am very light. So do you carry me in your hands and spcedily go.'

sa: स त्वं कुरु तथा तात स्वमतेन पितामह। यथा जीवन्ति ते पौत्राः प्रीतिमन्तः परस्परम्॥
en: You, who have done this, now do what according to your own opinion, O Grandsire, will enable your grandsons to live in peace and amity with each other.

sa: सत्यं च धर्मं च पराक्रमं च भूतानुकम्पां प्रियवादितां च। द्विजातिदेवातिथिपूजनं च पन्थानमाहुत्रिदिवस्य सन्तः॥
en: Truth, righteousness, prowess, kindness to creatures, fair spokeness, and worship of the twice-born ones, gods and guests, these have by the pious been styled the ways to heaven.

sa: न रामः कर्कशस्तात नाविद्वान् नाजितेन्द्रियः। अनृतं न श्रुतं चैव नैव त्वं वक्तुमर्हसि ॥
en: Rāma, O my child is not harsh or foolish; nor has he not control over his senses. Far from speaking untruth he does not know false stories even.

sa: ततः कालेन महता विश्वामित्रो महातपाः॥ चकारावाहनं तत्र भागार्थं सर्वदेवताः। नाभ्यागमंस्तदा तत्र भागार्थं सर्वदेवताः॥
en: Then after a long time, Viśvāmitra of mighty austerities invoked thither all the celestials for receiving their respective shares; but the deities did not come to receive them.

sa: मां भजस्व चिराय त्वमहं श्लाघ्यः पतिस्तव। नैव चाहं क्वचिद् भद्रे करिष्ये तव विप्रियम्॥
en: I am a worthy husband for you. Do you serve me for ever, your praiseworthy husband. O fine lady, I hall never do what you did not like.

sa: अथोत्तमान्याभरणानि देवि देहि स्नुषायै व्यपनीय चीरम्। न चीरमस्याः प्रविधीयतेति न्यवारयत् तद् वसनं वसिष्ठः॥
en: Do you, O noble lady, removing the ascetic guise, confer elegant ornaments on your daughter-in-law, for such a dress suits not this one, Saying this Vasistha prevented Kaikeyi.

sa: नैनं सूर्यः प्रतपति पार्श्वे वाति न मारुतः। चलोर्मिमाली तं दृष्ट्वा समुद्रोऽपि न कम्पते॥
en: And the Sun does not burn him, or the Wind blow about him; and at sight of him, that one engarlanded with billows, the Ocean, dares not stir.

sa: यदन्तरं सिंहसृगालयोने यदन्तरं स्यन्दनिकासमुद्रयोः। सुराग्र्यसौवीरकयोर्यदन्तरं तदन्तरं दाशरथेस्तवैव च।।४५ यदन्तरं काञ्चनसीसलोहया र्यदन्तरं चन्दनवारिपङ्कयोः। यदन्तरं हस्तिबिडालयोर्वने तदन्तरं दाशरथेस्तवैव च। यदन्तरं वायसवैनतेययो र्यदन्तरं मद्गुमयूरयोरपि। यदन्तरं हंसकगृध्रयोर्वने तदन्तरं दाशरथेस्तवैव च।।४७। तस्मिन् सहस्राक्षसमप्रभावे रामे स्थिते कार्मुकबाणपाणौ हृतापि तेऽहं न जरां गमिष्ये आज्यं यथा मक्षिकयावगीर्णम्।४८।।
en: Mighty is the difference between Rāma and you, like to that between a lion and a jackal, a sea and a rivulet, nectar and gruel, gold and iron, sandal and mud, an elephant and a cat, a crow and Garuda, a peacock and a madgie (an acquatic bird), or a duck and a vulture. Even If you did steal me, that mighty archer Rāma, gifted with the prowess of the lord celestials, living, surely shall I die, like to a gnat sucking clarified butter.

sa: ऋतवश्चापि षट् चान्ये मासाः संवत्सरास्तथा। कलाश्च काष्ठाश्च तथा तव शर्म दिशन्तु ते॥ महावनेऽपि चरतो मुनिवेषस्य धीमतः। तथा देवाश्च दैत्याश्च भवन्तु सुखदाः सदा॥ राक्षसानां पिशाचानां रौद्राणां क्रूरकर्मणाम्। क्रव्यादानां च सर्वेषां मा भूत् पुत्रक भयम्॥
en: May the six seasons, months years and all the divisions of time confer upon you pleasure always, when you of great intelligence shall wander away into the forest in the attire of an ascetic. May the deities and demons ever minister to your happiness and may not fear proceed to you, Oh my son, from the terrible Rākṣāṣās and Piśācas intent on committing cruel deeds, and other animals living on flesh.

sa: ब्रूहि लक्ष्मण वैदेही यदि जीवति वा न वा। त्वयि प्रमत्ते रक्षोभिर्भक्षिता वा तपस्विनी॥
en: tell me, O Laksmana, whether Do you Videha's daughter live or not; or whether, in consequence of your acting heedlessly, that forlorn wench has been devoured by Raksasas.

sa: ततः प्राप्तमृषि ज्ञात्वा तानि सत्त्वानि वै ययुः। प्रविष्टे राजनि यथा सर्वं सामात्यकं बलम्॥
en: And knowing that the saint had arrived (at his home), the animals went away, as go away forces together with counsellors, when the sovereign has entered (his palace).

sa: परमं खलु ते वीर्यं दृश्यते राक्षसाधम। विश्राव्य नामधेयं हि युद्धे नास्मि जिता त्वया॥ ईदृशं गर्हितं कर्म कथं कृत्वा न लज्जसे। स्त्रियाश्चाहरणं नीच रहिते च परस्य च ॥
en: Great, forsooth, is found to be your might, you vilest of Rākşasas, in that you have carried me off; by simply declaring your name, but have not won me in war. Why do you not, O execrable one, take shame to yourself, having perpetrated such a heinous act-having carried off another's wife in the absence of her husband?

sa: मयस्य मायाविहितं तद् बिलं च विचिन्वताम्। व्यतीतस्तत्र नो मासो यो राज्ञा समयः कृतः॥
en: That cave, you must know, was constructed by the illusive energy of Maya. And there we spent a month the term which had been fixed by the monarch.

sa: न क्षमं चापराद्धानां गमनं स्वामिपार्श्वतः। प्रधानभूताश्च वयं सुग्रीवस्य समागताः॥ इहैव सीतामन्वीक्ष्य प्रवृत्तिमुपलभ्य वा। नो चेद् गच्छाम तं वीरं गमिष्यामो यमक्षयम्॥
en: Those who have transgressed, cannot come to the side of their master. Having come hither as the principal servants of Sugrīva, we shall either see Sītā or obtain information concerning her, or else, O hero, we shall repair to the mansion of Yama.

sa: किं मामेवं प्रलपती प्रियां त्वं नाभिभाषसे। इमाः पश्य वरा बढ्यो भार्यास्ते वानरेश्वर ॥
en: O lord of monkeys, why did you not welcome me, your beloved spouse, who am bewailing thus? Behold, your other wives are also mourning in the same wise.

sa: ते वयं प्रच्युता राज्यात् कैकेय्यास्तु कृते त्रयः॥ विचराम द्विजश्रेष्ठ वनं गम्भीरमोजसा। समाश्वस मुहूर्ते तु शक्यं वस्तुमिह त्वया।२२।। आगमिष्यति मे भर्ता वन्यमादाय पुष्कलम्। रु.न् गोधान् वराहांश्च हत्वाऽऽदायामिषं बहु ॥ स त्वं नाम च गोत्रं च कुलमाचक्ष्व तत्त्वतः। एकश्च दण्डकारण्ये किमर्थं चरसि द्विज॥
en: O you the best of twice-born ones, we three being deprived of our kingdom by Kaikeyi have been living in this dense forest by virtue of our ! effulgence. Do you take heart for a moment and live here. Instantly shall my husband return with good many wild fruits and roots and with sufficient meat after killing many a deer, hog and Gosamp. Truly do you relate to me your name, Gotra and leneage. O you twice-born one, why do you range alone in this forest of Dandaka?

sa: आदेशो वनवासस्य प्राप्तव्यः स मया किल। सा त्वया सह भर्ताहं यास्यामि प्रिय नान्यथा॥
en: O mighty hero, to go to the forest; I shall therefore obtain permission and go, O dearly beloved to the forest with you; nothing can make it otherwise.

sa: सह राघव वैदेह्या भ्रात्रा चैव वने वसन्। त्वं गतिं प्राप्स्यसे वीर त्रींल्लोकांस्तु जयन्निव॥
en: O Rāghava, living in the forest with Vaidehi and your brother, you, O Lord, attain a state (of supreme excellence), having, as it were, conquered the three worlds.

sa: स मे ज्येष्ठसुतः श्रीमान् धर्मज्येष्ठ इतीव मे। तत् त्वया प्रियवादिन्या सेवार्थं कथितं भवेत्॥
en: That blessed one is my eldest son, and the most righteous of them all even this, with the view of pleasing me, you sweet speeched one had said.

sa: एष ते विस्तरो राम शैलपुत्र्या निवेदितः। गङ्गायाः प्रभवं चैव शृणु मे सहलक्ष्मण ॥
en: I have now related to you, O Rāma, the spread of the Mountain's daughter, (Gangā). Do you now together with Lakşmaņa listen to the narration of Bhāgīrathi's potency.

sa: मारीच श्रूयतां तात वचनं मम भाषतः। आर्तोऽस्मि मम चार्तस्य भवान् हि परमा गतिः॥
en: O Mărîca, hearken to me, my child, as I relate (everything to you). I am distressed and in this distress of mine, you are certainly my great refuge.

sa: कौसल्या च सुमित्रा च पुत्रशोकाभिपीडिते। . दुष्करं यदि जीवेतां प्राप्य त्वां जननी मम॥
en: Afflicted with grief for their son, even if Kausalya and Sumitrā live, it will be hard for them to do so in the presence of you, my mother.

sa: सम्प्राप्तोऽयमरिर्वीर भरतो वध्य एव हि। भरतस्य वधे दोषं नाहं पश्यामि राघव॥ पूर्वापकारिणं हत्वा न ह्यधर्मेण युज्यते। पूर्वापकारी भरतस्त्यागे धर्मश्च राघव॥
en: Surely, Bharata should be slain by me. O Rāghava, fault find I none in slaying Bharata; slaying a former wronger, one does not reap unrighteousness. O Raghava, there is religious merit to be reaped by slaying Bharata, who had formerly done us wrong.

sa: कर्मभिश्चिन्तितो लोको गत्यां गत्यां पृथग्विधः। तस्मात् कर्माणि नित्यानि लोभान्मोक्षं यियासति॥ नेहधर्मानृशंस्याभ्यां च क्षान्त्या नार्जवेन च। पुरुषः श्रियमाप्नोति न घृणित्वेन कर्हिचित्॥
en: By actions men are placed in different situations of life; consequences of action are inevitable, from ignorance people desire for the liberation from action. A man does not even attain prosperity in this world by virtue, gentleness, forgiveness, straight-forwardness and fear of censure.

sa: तेषूपवासान विबुधानुपोष्य दत्त्वा च रत्नानि महान्ति राजा। तीर्थेषु सर्वेषु परिप्लुताङ्गः पुनः स शूर्पारकमाजगाम्॥
en: The king observed many fasts in these Tirthas and gave away many costly gems. Having bathed his body in these holy places, he again came back to Shurparaka.

sa: यक्षी वा राक्षसी वा त्वमुताहोऽसि वराङ्गना। सर्वथा कुरु नः स्वस्ति रक्ष वास्माननिन्दिते॥ यथायं सर्वथा सार्थः क्षेमी शीघ्रमितो व्रजेत्। तथा विधत्स्व कल्याणि यथा श्रेयो हि नो भवेत्।।
en: Be you a female Yaksha or a female Rakshasa or a heavenly damsel, do good unto us and O blaimeless one! protect us completely. O blessed one! do you so ordain that, ere long, this caravan may start from this place attended with prosperity in every direction, as also that poor personal property may be secured.

sa: गृहणीत बध्नीत विकर्ततेमं पचाम खादाम च भीमसेनम्। क्रुद्धा ब्रुवन्तोऽभिययुटुंतं ते शस्त्राणि चोद्यम्य विवृत्तनेत्राः॥
en: With rolling eyes, they upraised their arms and rushed in anger at Bhimasena, crying "Seize him" "Bind him," "Cut him down" "Look to Bhima and eat him up."

sa: मार्कण्डेय उवाच ततः स राजा संहृष्टः सिद्धे पक्षे महामनाः। तमत्रिमब्रवीत् प्रीतः पूर्वं येनाभिसंस्तुतः॥
en: Markandeya said : Then the high minded king, greatly satisfied with the victorious party who first spoke in high terms of him, gladly addressed him with these words.

sa: आविशन्ति च यं यक्षाः पुरुषं कालपर्यये। उन्माद्यति स तु क्षिप्रं ज्ञेयो यक्षग्रहस्तु सः।।५३
en: When a Yaksha spirit by some means or other enters the body of a human being, he immediately turns mad. Such a spirit is called the Yaksha spirit.

sa: पतिशुश्रूषया धर्मो य: स मे रोचते द्विज। दैवतेष्वपि सर्वेषु भर्ता मे दैवतं परम्॥
en: O regenerate one, the merit, that is derived from the worship of my husband, is liked by me. Of all the gods, my husband is my highest deity.

sa: तदश्वतीर्थं विख्यातमुत्थिता यत्र ते हयाः। गङ्गायां कान्यकुब्जे वै ददौ सत्यवतीं तदा।॥ ततो गाधिः सुतां चास्मै जन्याश्चासन् सुरास्तदा। लब्वा हयसहस्रं तु तांश्च दृष्ट्वा दिवौकसः॥ धर्मेण लब्ध्वा तां भार्यामृचीको द्विजसत्तमः। यथाकामं यथाजोषं तया रेमे सुमध्यया॥
en: The place, where the horses rose from the Ganges in Kanyakubja, is celebrated as the Horse-Tiriha. And then the king bestowed Satyavati (his daughter to Rechika). In the marriage of the daughter of Gadhi even the celestials were present. Thus that foremost of Brahmana Rechika obtained one thousand horses. Saw the dwellers of heaven and got a wife according to the ordinance. He then sported with that slender-waisted damsel at pleasure.

sa: दमघोषात्मजं वीरं संस्कारयत मा चिरम्। तथा च कृतवन्तस्ते भ्रातु शासनं तदा॥ चेदीनामाधिपत्ये च पुत्रमस्य महीपतेः। अभ्यषिञ्चत् तदा पार्थः सह तैर्वसुधाधिपः॥
en: The heroic son of Damaghosha without delay and with all proper respect. They obeyed (their brother's command). Then the son of Pritha (Yudhishthira), with his brothers and with all the kings, installed the son of the king Shishupala in the kingdom of Chedi.

sa: कहोड उवाच इत्यर्थमिच्छन्ति सुताञ्जना जनक कर्मणा। यदहं नाशकं कर्तुं तत् पुत्रः कृतवान् मम॥
en: Kahoda said: O Janaka, it is for this reason men desire for sons by performing virtuous acts. That in which I failed has been done by my son.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच आहूतो न निवर्तेयमिति मे व्रतमाहितम्। विधिश्च बलवान् राजन् दिष्टस्यामि वशे स्थितः॥
en: Yudhishthira said. O king, challenged, I do not withdraw; this is my established vow. (I know) fate is (all) powerful. We are all under the sway of Fate.

sa: वासुदेव उवाच हतं श्रुत्वा महाबाहो मया श्रौतश्रवं नृप। उपायाद् भरतश्रेष्ठ शाल्वो द्वारवतीं पुरीम्॥
en: Krishna said: O mighty-armed king, O best of the Bharata race, having heard that the son of Shrutasrava (Shishupala) was killed, Shalva came to the city of Daravati.

sa: काश्यो यद् धनमाहार्षीद् द्रव्यं यच्चान्यदुत्तमम्। तथान्ये पृथिवीपाला यानि रत्नान्युपाहरन्॥ वाहनानि धनं चैव कवचान्यायुधानि च। राज्यमात्मा वयं चैव कैतवेन हृतं परैः॥
en: Whatever wealth and other excellent articles which the king of Kashi gave, and the gems and jewels, animals, wealth, armours, and weapons which the other kings, presented, nay even our kingdom, yourself and ourselves, have all been won by our enemies at play.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच समाज्ञप्तास्ततो दूताः पाण्डवेयस्य शासनात्। आमन्त्रयाम्बभूवुश्च आनयंश्चापरान् द्रुतम्। तथा परानपि नरानात्मनः शीघ्रगामिनः॥
en: At the command of the Pandavas those swift messengers invited every one without any loss of time, and they brought with them many persons both friends and strangers.

sa: असंतोषः श्रियो मूलं तस्मात् तं कामयाम्यहम्। समुच्छ्रये यो यतते स राजन् परमो नयः॥
en: O king, discontent is the root of prosperity. Therefore, I desire to have it. O king, he who tries to acquire prosperity is truly a man of policy.

sa: अष्टावक्र उवाच भो भो राजञ्जनकानां वरिष्ठ त्वं वै सम्राट् त्वयि सर्वं समृद्धम्। त्वं वा कर्ता कर्मणां यज्ञियानां ययातिरेको नृपतिर्वा पुरस्तात्॥
en: Ashtavakra said: O king, O best of Janaka's race, you are an emperor and all wealth rest in you. In the days of yore, Yayati was the (great) performer of sacrifices and in the modern age you are the great performer of sacrifices.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच तां तथा ब्रुवतीं श्रुत्वा भृशं लज्जाऽऽवृतोऽर्जुनः उवाच कर्णौ हस्ताभ्यां पिधाय त्रिदशालये॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Hearing her speak there in that heaven in this way, Arjuna was filled with great shame. He shut his ears with his hands and said.

sa: मनसा कर्मणा वाचा शुश्रूषा नैव हीयते। न चान्या हि तथा बुद्धिदृश्यते साम्प्रतं तव॥
en: In thought, in word or in action, your attention to us never flags and it appears, even at present, that you have no other thought in your mind.

sa: आशंसते हि पुत्रेषु पिता माता च भारत। यशः कीर्तिमथैश्वर्यं प्रजा धर्मं तथैव च॥
en: O descendant of the Bharata race, both the father and the mother aspire that the son is possessed of fame and celebration, wealth and subjects, as also virtue.

sa: मम राज्यं प्रणष्टं यन्नाहं तत् कृतवान् स्वयम्। कलिना तत् कृतं भीरु यच्च त्वामहमत्यजम्॥
en: "O timid one, the loss of my kingdom was not wrought by me. It was done by Kali, on whose account I had abandoned you in the woods.

sa: धर्म उवाच नान्यः कर्तुः फलं राजन्नुपभुङ्क्ते कदाचन। इमानि तव दृश्यन्ते फलानि वदतां वर॥
en: Dharmaraja said : O king, O foremost of speakers, one cannot suffer or enjoy for another person's acts. These are the fruits of your acts. See them here.

sa: श्रीकृष्ण उवाच शाल्वस्य नगरं सौभं गतोऽहं भरतर्षभ। निहन्तुं कौरवश्रेष्ठ तत्र मे शृणु कारणम्॥ महातेजा महाबाहुर्यः स राजा महायशाः। दमघोषात्मजो वीरः शिशुपालो मया हतः॥ यज्ञे ते भरतश्रेष्ठ राजसूयेऽर्हणां प्रति। स रोषवशमापन्नो नामृष्यत दुरात्मवान्॥ श्रुत्वा तं निहतं शाल्वस्तीव्ररोषसमन्वितः। उपायाद् द्वारकां शून्यामिहस्थे मयि भारत॥
en: Srikrishna said : O Bharata chief, O foremost of the Kurus, I went to destroy the city of Shalva; listen to the reasons thereof. O foremost of the Bharatas, at the sacrifice of Rajasuya, the heroic son of Damaghosha, the highly effulgent, the mightyarmed and the illustrious king Shishupala was killed by me, for he could not bear to see the first worship offered to me. O descendant of Bharata, having heard of his destruction, Shalva, stricken with dreadful anger, went to the empty Dvarka, myself living here.

sa: नारायणी चेन्द्रसेना बभूव वश्या नित्यं मुद्गलस्याजमीढ। तथा शान्ता ऋष्यशृङ्गं वनस्थं प्रीत्या युक्ता पर्यचरनरेन्द्र।॥
en: Or as Indrasena, the daughter of Narayana, was to Mudgala. O descendant of Ajamida, O ruler of men, thus did Shanta affectionately wait upon Rishyashringa in the forest.

sa: न स्म प्रज्ञायते किंचिदम्भसा समवस्तृते। समं वा विषमं वापि नद्यो वा स्थावराणि च॥
en: When the (surface of the earth was flooded with water it could not be discerned whether the ground was even or uneven or whether there were rivers, ground.

sa: रुद्र उवाच कार्येष्वहं त्वया पुत्र संद्रष्टव्यः सदैव हि। दर्शनान्मम भक्त्या च श्रेयः परमवाप्स्यसि॥
en: Rudra said: O son, you shall always find me in the field of battle. By looking at me and by devotion to me, you shall derive great good.

sa: पुष्पहेतोः कथं त्वार्यः करिष्यति युधिष्ठिरः। स्नेहान्नरवरो नूनमविश्वासाद् बलस्य च॥ नकुलं सहदेवं च न मोक्ष्यति युधिष्ठिरः। कथं तु कुसुमावाप्तिः स्याच्छीघ्रमिति चिन्तयन्।।३४।
en: In search of the flowers, what will Yudhishthira now do from affection; and doubting their prowess, that foremost of men Yudhishthira will not allow Nakula and Sahadeva to come in search of us. How can I obtain the flowers soon?" He thought thus.

sa: ममत्वं हि न कर्तव्यमैश्वर्ये वा धनेऽपि वा। पूर्वावाप्तं हरन्त्यन्ये राजधर्मं हि तं विदुः॥
en: None should love his wealth and affluence, for the wealth, that has been earned and hoarded, might be plundered. This (such plundering) is the usage of the kings.

sa: यो हि दोग्ध्रीमुपास्ते च स नित्यं विन्दते पयः। एव राष्ट्रमुपायेन भुञ्जानो लभते फलम्॥
en: He, who treats a milch cow with kindness, always obtains milk from it. Likewise the king, who rules his kingdom by proper means, gets much fruits from it.

sa: उदारं यद् भवानाह नैतच्चित्रं भवद्विधे। विहितो यस्तु मार्गो मे हितार्थं शृणु तं मम॥
en: You have spoken most magnanimously. It could be expected from one like you. Hear I shall describe the expedient I have thought of for benefiting both of us.

sa: ततः शङ्खांश्च भेरीश्च शतशश्चैव पुष्कलान्।॥ अवादयन्त पञ्चालाः सिंहनादांश्च नेदिरे। तेऽभ्यधावन्त संरब्धा मद्रराजं तरस्विनम्॥
en: Having made that vow, the king proceeded against the king of the Madras. The Panchalas then blew and beat numberless conchs and drums and sent up leonine roars.

sa: ततो गान्धारराजस्य पुत्रः शकुनिरब्रवीत्॥ दुर्योधनं महाराज वचनं वचनक्षमः। किं न सम्प्रेक्षमाणानां मद्राणां हन्यते बलम्। न युक्तमेतत् समरे त्वयि तिष्ठति भारत।
en: Then Sakuni, the eloquent son of the Gandhara king, O king, said to Duryodhana these words:-How is this that we are standing here, while the Madraka army is being killed before our eyes? O Bharata,when you are here, it does not look well!

sa: ततः प्रयाता: कुरवो जवेन श्रुत्वैव शङ्खस्वनमीर्यमाणम्। विहाय मद्राधिपति पतिं च दुर्योधन भारत भारतानाम्॥
en: No sooner the Kauravas heard the blare of the conchs then they speedily left the battlefield leaving behind them the king of Madras and the Bharata chief Duryodhana.

sa: उत्थानेन सदा पुत्र दैवतान्यर्चयित्वा हि ब्राह्मणांश्च कुरूद्वह। आनृण्यं याति धर्मस्य लोकेन च समर्च्यते॥
en: By adoring the celestials and the Brahmanas, O increaser of Kuru's race, the king satisfies his debt to duty and morality, and acquires the respect of his subjects.

sa: ऐल उवाच साध्वसाधून् धारयतीह भूमिः साध्वसाधूंस्तापयतीह सूर्यः। साध्वसाधूंश्चापि वातीह वायु रापस्तथा साध्वसाधून् पुनन्ति॥
en: Aila said The Earth contains the honest and the wicked. The sun warms the honest and the wicked. The wind blows equally for them. Water cleanses them equally.

sa: शिरः कायानुरूपं न कर्णी नेत्रे तथैव च। तस्य वाक्चैव चेष्टा च सामान्ये राजसत्तम॥
en: His head was proportionate to his body, and his ears and eyes, also, were the same. His speech, O best of kings, and his movements were highly feeble.

sa: शारीरं द्रव्यमुत्सृज्य पृथिवीमनुशासतः। यो धर्मो यत् सुखं वा स्यात् सुहृदां तत् तथास्तु नः।।३
en: On the other hand, inay our friends enjoy that religious merit and happiness which fall 1O cause him, who governs the Earth, having shaken off all internal attachments.

sa: अस्मद्वेषेण संतप्तः सुखं न स्मेह विन्दति। ऋद्धिमस्मासु तां दृष्ट्वा विवर्णो हरिणः कृशः॥ धृतराष्ट्रश्च नृपतिः सौबलेन निवेदितः। तं पिता पुत्रगृद्धित्वादनुमेनेऽनये स्थितः॥
en: Burning with the hate they cherished against us, they could not enjoy happiness and peace. Witnessing advancement, Duryodhana became colourless, pale and emaciated. Suvala's son informed king Dhritarashtra of this. Like an indulgent father, Dhritarashtra tolerated the evil policy of his Our son.

sa: आहवे तु हतं शूरं न शोचेत कथंचन॥ अशोच्यो हि हतः शूरः स्वर्गलोके महीयते।
en: One should never lament for a hero killed in battle. A killed hero, if nobody grieves for him, goes to heaven and acquires the respect of its residents.

sa: निःसपत्ना मही यस्य त्रयोदश समाः स्थिता। स शेते निहतो भूमौ पुत्रो मे पृथिवीपतिः॥
en: He who had unrivaled away over the Earth, for thirteen years, alas, that prince, that son of mine, sleeps to-day on the naked Earth, killed by his foes.

sa: जीवितं तव दुष्प्रज्ञं मयि सम्प्रति वर्तते॥ जीवयेयमहं कामं न तु त्वं जीवितुं क्षमः।
en: Your life, O indiscrect man, now depends upon me, If, I like, I can allow you to live, but you are not capable of saving your own life.

sa: अल्पं च बलमेतेषां कृष्णौ च भृशविक्षतौ॥ यदि सर्वेऽत्र तिष्ठामो ध्रुवं नो विजयो भवेत्।
en: The army of the Pandavas had been reduced in nuinbers. The two Krishnas are greatly wounded. If all of us make a stand, we will surely acquire victory.

sa: गर्भस्थो वा प्रसूतो वाप्यथ वा दिवसान्तरः। अर्धमासगतो वापि मासमात्रगतोऽपि वा॥ संवत्सरगतो वापि द्विसंवत्सर एव वा। यौवनस्थोऽथ मध्यस्थो वृद्धो वापि विपद्यते॥
en: Some are destroyed while in embryo, some after coming out of the womb, some on the day after, some after a fortnight or a month, some on after a year or two, some in youth, some in middle age, and some when old.

sa: कृत्वा विमर्द महदर्जुनेन कर्णो हत: केसरिणेव नागः। तीर्णा प्रतिज्ञा पुरुषर्षभेण वैरस्यान्तं गतवांश्चापि पार्थः॥
en: After a dreadful fight Karna was killed by Arjuna as an elephant is slain by a lion. The sons best of men Arjuna thus did wreck his vengeance.

sa: भवत्प्रतीक्षः कृष्णोऽसौ धर्मराज महाद्युते। यदत्रानन्तरं कृत्यं तद् भवान् कर्तुमर्हति॥ एवमुक्तः प्रत्युवाच धर्मपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः।
en: O righteous, great, and powerful king! Krishna is waiting for you. You should now do what should be done next. Thus addressed, Dharma's son Yudhishthira answered as follows.

sa: भ्रातृभ्यां पशुलुब्धाभ्यामुत्सृष्टः स महातपाः। उदपाने तदा राजन् निर्जले पांसुसंवृते॥ त्रित आत्मानमालक्ष्य कूपे वीरुत्तृणावृते।
en: Thus left behind by his two brothers who were tempted to appropriate those animals, the great ascetic. Trita, O king, while within that lonely pit covered with dust.

sa: न च क्व चिदविन्दत् स भिक्षमाणोऽपि कौशिकः। मांसमन्नं फलं मूलमन्यद् वा तत्र किञ्चन॥
en: Though the son of Kushila begged again and again, yet he could not get any meat or rice or fruit or root or any other kind of food.

sa: मन्यते कर्षयित्वा तु क्षमा साध्वीति शम्बरः। असंतप्तं तु यद् दारु प्रत्येति प्रकृति पुनः॥
en: Shamvara has said that having assailed an enemy, forgiveness should be shown afterwards, for a wooden pole, if made straight without heat, very soon assumes its former state.

sa: चिरं ह्यपि जडः शूरः पण्डितं पर्युपास्य हि। न स धर्मान् विजानाति दर्वी सूपरसानिव॥
en: By waiting all his life upon a learned person, a brave man, void of understanding, cannot know his duties like a wooden ladle unable to taste the soup.

sa: भीष्म उवाच वस्तव्यं यत्र कौन्तेय सपुत्रज्ञातिबन्धुना। न्याय्यं तत्र परिप्रष्टुं वृत्तिं गुप्तिं च भारत॥
en: Bhishma said “It is proper, O Bharata, to enquire about how should a king live on a city, and how should he defend it, O son of Kunti.

sa: शब्दाः स्पर्शास्तथा गन्धा विचरन्ति मनः प्रियाः। धैर्यं चाविशते योधान् विजयस्य मुखं च तत्॥
en: If sweet sounds and odours and sensations of touch prevail, and if the warriors are filled with gratitude and patience, it is regarded as the root of success.

sa: तौ शङ्खशब्देन निनादयन्तौ वनानि शैलान् सरितो गुहाश्च। वित्रासयन्तौ तव पुत्रसेनां युधिष्ठिरं नन्दयतां वरिष्टौ॥
en: Resounding the woods, mountains, rivers and cardinal points with the blare of their conchs and filling up your soldiers with terror those two foremost of men gladdened Yudhishthira.

sa: चापानि रुक्माङ्गभूषणानि शराश्च कार्तस्वरचित्रपुङ्काः। ऋष्टयश्च पीता विमला विकोशाः प्रासाश्च दण्डै कनकावभासैः॥ श्छिन्नापविद्धाश्च स्रजो विचित्राः। कुथाः पताकाम्बरभूषणानि किरीटमाला मुकुटाश्च शुभ्राः॥ प्रकीर्णका विप्रकीर्णाश्च राजन् प्रवालमुक्तातरलाश्च हाराः। आपीडकेयूरवराङ्गदानि ग्रैवेयनिष्काः ससुवर्णसूत्राः॥ मण्युत्तमा वज्रसुवर्णमुक्ता रत्नानि चोचावचमङ्गलानि। गात्राणि चात्यन्तसुखोचितानि शिरासिं चेन्दुप्रतिमाननानि॥ देहाचं भोगाचं परिच्छादांश्च त्यक्तवा मनोज्ञानि सुखानि चैव। स्वधर्मनिष्ठां महसतीमवाप्
en: It was covered with gold decked bows, gold-winged arrows, bright and unsheathed swords of good metal, lances, scimitars shining like gold, umbrellas, fans conchs, armours, painted with beautiful flowers of gold, trappings of elephants, standards, car-fences, crowns, necklaces, yalk tails, garlands of corals and pearls, chaplets, ornaments for the wrist and upper arms, golden collars for the neck, various precious diamonds, jems and pearls, beautiful moon-like heads and bodies brought up in luxury. Leaving behind their mortal coils, luxurious pleasures and dresses, acquiring glory by proving faithful to the duties of their caste they have gone with giory to the region of bliss.

sa: त्वत्तः कृशतरं किं नु ब्रवीतु भगवानिदम्। यदि गुह्यं न ते किञ्चिद् विद्यते मुनिसत्तम॥
en: What is slenderer than your body? Tell me this, O holy one, if, however, O best of sages, the subject is one, which may fairly be dealt with.

sa: भीष्म उवाच एतत् कथितवान् पुत्रे धृतराष्ट्रो नराधिपः। एतत् कुरुष्व कौन्तेय ततः प्राप्स्यसि तत्फलम्॥
en: Bhishma said This was what king Dhritarashtra said to his son. Do you follow these instructions, O son of Kunti, and you will then surely acquire their fruit.

sa: देवयान्युवाच यद्येतदेवं शर्मिष्ठे न मन्युर्विद्यते मम। अपत्यं यदि ते लब्धं ज्येष्ठाच्छ्रेष्ठाच वै द्विजात्॥
en: Devayani said : O Sharmishtha, If this be true, if you have received this your son from such a great Brahmana, I have then no cause for anger.

sa: यदाश्रौषं द्रोगापुत्रेण गर्भे वैराटया वै पात्यमाने महास्त्रैः। द्वैपायन: केशवो द्रोणपुत्रं परस्परेणाभिशापैः :: शशाप॥
en: I had no hope of success, O Sanjaya, when I heard that for wounding the son in the womb of Uttara both Krishna and Dvaipayana had cursed him.

sa: यदाश्रौषं भीमसेनेन पीतं रक्तं भ्रातुर्युधि दुःशासनस्य। निवारितं नान्यतमेन भीम तदा नाशंसे विजयाय संजय॥
en: I had no hope of success, O Sanjaya, when I heard that Bhima had drunk the blood of his cousin Dushasana and none was able to prevent him.

sa: वसव ऊचुः प्रतीपस्य सुतो राजा शान्तनुर्लोकविश्रुतः। भविता मानुषे लोके स नः कर्ता भविष्यति॥
en: The Vasus said : There will be born on earth a son to Pratipa who will be a greatly famous king. He will be our father on earth.

sa: नारद उवाच पाञ्चाली भवतामेका धर्मपत्नी यशस्विनी। यथा वो नात्र भेदः स्यात् तथा नीतिविधीयताम्॥
en: Narada said: The illustrious princess of Panchala is the wedded wife of all of you establish a rule amongst yourselves so that no dissension may arise amongst you.

sa: यदा द्रोणो विविधानस्त्रमार्गान् निदर्शयन् समरे चित्रयोधी। न पाण्डवाञ्च्छ्रेष्ठतरान् निहन्ति तदा नाशंसे विजयाय संजय॥
en: I had no hope of success, O Sanjaya, when I heard that Drona though he displayed many modes of fight, had not killed any of the chief Pandavas.

sa: जनमेजय उवाच अथ तत्कथितं केन यद्वृत्तं तद्वनस्पतौ। आश्चर्यभूतं लोकस्य भस्मराशिकृतं तदा॥ यवृक्षं जीवयामास काश्यपस्तक्षकेण वै। नूनं मन्त्रैर्हतविषो न प्रणश्येत काश्यपात्॥
en: Janamejaya said : From whom have you heard this wonderful account of the lord of the forest, burnt to ashes by Takshaka and revived again by Kashyapa? My father could not have certainly died were the poison neutralised by the Mantras of Kashyapa.

sa: आचक्ष्व भद्रे भर्तुः स्वं सर्वमेव विचेष्टितम्। उद्धरस्व च शल्यं मे घोरं हृदि चिरस्थितम्॥
en: O amiable sister, tell me all that your husband has done and thereby (relieve me by drawing out the terribly painful dart that is implanted in my heart.

sa: यस्य कन्यास्ति भूतस्य ये मयेह प्रकीर्तिताः। ते मे कन्यां प्रयच्छन्तु चरतः सर्वतो दिशम्॥
en: Let any of those creatures, whom I (now) address, if he has a daughter, bestow her on me who am roving all over the world for a bride.

sa: न हि मृत्युं तथा राजा श्रुत्वा वै सोऽन्वतप्यत। अशोचदमरप्रख्यो यथा कृत्वेह कर्म तत्॥
en: The king, who looked like a celestial, did not grieve so much for hearing that he would die, as for having done that (insulting) act to the Rishi.

sa: जनमेजय उवाच सुवर्ण रजतं गाश्च यच्चान्यन्मन्यसे विभो। तत्ते दद्यां वरं विप्र न निवर्तेत्क्रतुर्मम॥
en: Janamejaya said : O illustrious man, I shall give you gold, silver, kine, or whatever else you desire to possess. But let not my this sacrifice be stopped.

sa: परिश्रान्तः पिपासात आससाद मुनि वने। गवां प्रचारेष्वासीनं वत्सानां मुखनिःसृतम्॥ भूयिष्ठमुपयुञ्जानं फेनमापिबतां पयः। तमभिद्रुत्य वेगेन स राजा संशितव्रतम्॥ अपृच्छद्धनुरुद्यम्य तं मुनि क्षुच्छ्रमान्वितः। भो भो ब्रह्मन्नहं राजा परीक्षिदभिमन्युजः॥
en: Fatigued and thirsty he came upon a Rishi, in the forest, seated in a cow-shed, drinking the froth oozing out of the mouths of the calves sucking the milk of their mothers. Coming to him with all haste, the king asked that Rishi of great austerity, O Brahmana, I am king Parikshit, the son of Abhimanyu.

sa: कुले जन्म प्रशंसन्ति वैद्याः साधु सुनिष्ठिता। बलेन सदृशं नास्ति वीर्यं तु मम रोचते॥
en: All famous men of learning always praise in good society the nobleness of descent; but nothing is equal to prowess. There is nothing I like more thari prowess.

sa: न स यज्ञो न भविता न स राजा तथाविधः। जनमेजयः पाण्डवेयो यतोऽस्माकं महद्भयम्॥
en: "That sacrifice is not such as would be prevented and Janamejaya of the Pandava race, who is our great terror, is not such as he can be obstructed.

sa: इति कृत्वा मतिं तां तु निश्चयार्थं सुनिश्चिताम्। गृध्रोलूको प्रपद्येतां कोपाविष्टौ हमर्षितौ॥ रामं प्रपद्य तौ शीघ्रं कलिव्याकुलचेतसौ। तौ परस्परविद्वेषात्स्पृशतश्चरणौ तदा॥ अथ दृष्ट्वा नरेन्द्रं तं गधो वचनमब्रवीत्। सुराणामसुराणां च प्रधानस्त्वं मतो मम॥ बृहस्पतेश्च शुक्राच विशिष्टोऽसि महाधुते। परावरज्ञो भूतानां कात्या चन्द्र इवापरः॥
en: Having thus settled the vulture and the owl, being impatient with rage, quarrellirg with one another, appeaid before Rāma and touched his feet. Beholding that lord of men, the vulture said: "O preserver of humanity, you are the foremost of celestials and Asuras. O you of great effulgence, you are gifted with intelligence and learning more than BỊhaspati and Sukrácārya. You are cognisant of the good and bad conditions of creatures. In beauty you are like the Moon and are irrepressible like the Sun.

sa: उलूकश्चाब्रवीद्रामं पादपैरुपशोभिता। यदेयं पृथिवी राजंस्तदाप्रभृति मे गृहम्॥ एतच्छुत्वा तु वै रामः सभासदमुवाच ह॥ न सा सभा यत्र न सन्ति वृद्धा वृद्धा न ते ये न वदन्ति धर्मम्। नासौ धर्मो यत्र न सत्यमस्ति न तत्सत्यं यच्छलेनानुविद्धम्॥ ये तु सभ्याः सदा ज्ञात्वा तूष्णीं ध्यायन्त आसते। यथाप्राप्तं न बुवते ते सर्वेऽनृतवादिनः॥ जानन वाब्रवीत्प्रश्नान्कामात्क्रोधाद्भयात्तथा। सहस्रं वारुणान्याशानात्मनि प्रतिमुञ्चति॥ तेषां संवत्सरे पूर्णे पाश एकः प्रमुच्यते। तस्मात्सत्येन वक्तव्यं जानता सत्यमञ्जसा॥ एतच्छ्रुत
en: The owl also said: "At the time when the earth was (first) adorned with trees that this nest of mine was constructed." Hearing these words, Rama said to the councillors:-"That assembly is not an assembly where there are no friends—nor are they old men who do not dwell upon religious topics. That religion is not a religion where there is no truth and that truth is not the truth where there is hypocrisy. Those councillors are liars who do not give proper replies in time on the subjects they are well-informed on. He who does give reply to a question under the influence of passion, anger or fear, binds himself with. thousand nooses of Varuņa, and at the expiration of full one year he is released from a single sin.” Hearing these words, the ministers said to Rāma: "0 you having a large mind, wh

sa: तौ च हीनौ मया बालौ त्वया चैव तथाऽऽत्मजौ। विनश्येतां न संदेहो मत्स्याविव जलक्षये॥
en: There is no doubt these children of tender years, being bereft of me and you, will die as fish (in a tank) when the water is dried up.

sa: यस्य वीर्यं समाश्रित्य वसुपूर्णां वसुन्धराम्। इमां मन्यामहे प्राप्तां निहत्य धृतराष्ट्रजान्॥ तस्य व्यवसितस्त्यागो बुद्धिमास्थाय बुद्धिमास्थाय कां त्वया। कच्चिन्नु दुःखैर्बुद्धिस्ते विलुप्ता गतचेतसः॥
en: Relying on whose prowess we believe ourselves that we have already acquired this earth full of wealth and have killed the sons of Dhritarashira. On what consideration have you resolved upon abandoning him? have you lost your senses on account of the calamities?

sa: तुम्बुरुः पर्वतश्चैव शैलूषश्च तथापरः। चित्रसेनश्च गीतज्ञस्तथा चित्ररथोऽपि च॥ एते चान्ये च गन्धर्वा धनेश्वरमुपासते।
en: Tumbaru, Parvata, Shailusha, the great expert in music Chitrasena, Chitraratha, these and innumerable other Gandharvas worship the lord of wealth. The chief of Vidyadharas, Chakradharma with his followers,

sa: कश्यपस्य सुतो धीमानरुणेत्यभिविश्रुतः। महाकायो महातेजाः स स्थास्यति पुरो रवेः॥ करिष्यति च सारथ्यं तेजश्चास्य हरिष्यति। लोकानां स्वस्ति चैवं स्यादृषीणां च दिवौकसाम्।।
en: The wise son of Kashyapa, known by the name of Aruna, has a huge body. He will sit before the sun as his charioteer and will take energy. This will secure the good of the world, of the Rishis and of the celestials.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच पार्थः प्राप्य धनुः श्रेष्ठमक्षय्यौ च महेषुधी। रथं ध्वजं सभां चैव युधिष्ठिरमभाषत॥
en: Vaishampayana said Having obtained that best of bows (Gandiva) and the couple of inexhaustible quivers and the car and the (ape standard) flagstaff, Arjuna spoke to Yudhishthira thus.

sa: पुण्यां योनि पुण्यकृतो व्रजन्ति पापां योनि पापकृतो व्रजन्ति। कीटाः पतङ्गाश्च न मे विवक्षास्ति महानुभाव॥ चतुष्पदा द्विपदाः षट्पदाश्च तथाभूता गर्भभूता भवन्ति। आख्यातमेतन्निखिलेन सर्वं भूयस्तु किं पृच्छसि राजसिंह॥
en: The virtuous attain to a superior and the vicious to an inferior form of existence. The vicious becomes worms and insects. O illustrious one, I have nothing more to say. I have told you, how beings are born by the development of their embryonic formas quadrupeds, bipeds and six-footed creatures. What more will you ask me?

sa: न हि धर्मफलैस्तात न तपोभिः सुसंचितैः। तां गतिं प्राप्नुवन्तीह पुत्रिणो यां व्रजन्ति वै॥
en: O Son, not by the fruits of virtue, nor by the hoarded-up ascetic penances, does one acquire such merit as is acquired by one who is a father.

sa: आत्मनो बन्धुरात्मैव गतिरात्मैव चात्मनः। आत्मनो मित्रमात्मैव तथाऽऽत्मा चात्मनः पिता। आत्मनैवात्मनो दानं कर्तुमर्हसि धर्मतः॥
en: One is certainly one's own friend; one can certainly depend upon one's own self. Therefore, according to the ordinance, you yourself should bestow your own self on others.

sa: गन्धर्व उवाच कल्माषपाद इत्येवं लोके राजा बभूव ह। इक्ष्वाकुवंशजः पार्थ तेजसा सदृशो भुवि॥
en: The Gandharva said : O Partha there was a king named Kalmashapada in this world. He belonged to the race of Ikshaku and he was matchless in prowess.

sa: स तु दृष्टैव तं राजा क्रुद्ध उत्थाय भारत। आविष्टो रक्षसोग्रेण इयेषात्तुं तदा मुनिम्॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, on seeing him the king at once rose in anger and as he was possessed with the Rakshasas, he desired to devour the Rishi.

sa: वसिष्ठ उवाच वृत्तमेतद् यथाकालं गच्छ राज्यं प्रशाधि वै। ब्राह्मणं तु मनुष्येन्द्र भावमंस्थाः कदाचन।॥
en: Vasishtha said: o king of men, my desire has been fulfilled at the proper time. Return to your kingdom and rliic your subjects. Never (again) disregard the Brahmanas.

sa: तस्योत्तरीये निहितः स नागो भयोद्विग्नः शर्म नैवाभ्यगच्छत्। ततो राजा मन्त्रविदोऽब्रवीत्पुन: क्रुद्धो वाक्यं तक्षकस्यान्तमिच्छन्॥
en: The snake (Takshaka), however, kept himself hidden within the garments of Indra. Thereupon the king, being desirous of the destruction of Takshaka, spoke to his Mantraknowing Brahmanas thus,

sa: कथं स राजा स्त्रीभूतो वर्तयामास दुर्गतिः। पुरुषः स यदा भूतः कां वृत्तिं वर्तयत्यसौ॥
en: How could the king Ila subject himself to those afflictions in the shape of a female? And how did he use to behave himself in his male form?

sa: न हि सस्मार स नृपस्तं शापं काममोहितः। देव्याः सोऽथ वचः श्रुत्वा सम्भ्रान्तो नृपसत्तमः॥
en: Maddened by desire, the king had no recollection of the curse. Hearing the words of the lady (his wife), that best of kings become very much alarmed. a

sa: दाश उवाच अस्यां जायेत यः पुत्रः स राजा पृथिवीपते। त्वदूर्ध्वमभिषेक्तव्यो नान्यः कश्चन पार्थिव॥
en: The fisherman said: O king, the son that will be born of this girl shall be installed on your throne and none else shall you make your successor.

sa: गुणैरप्सरसां दिव्यैर्मेनके त्वं विशिष्यसे। श्रेयो मे कुरु कल्याणि यत् त्वां वक्ष्यामि तच्छृणु॥२२ असावादित्यसंकाशो विश्वामित्रो महातपाः। तप्यमानस्तपो घोरं मम कम्पयते मनः॥
en: "O Menaka, you are the best of all celestial Apsaras. O amiable girl, do me this service. Listen to what I say. The great ascetic Vishvamitra, as effulgent as the Sun, is now engaged in great asceticism and therefore my heart is trembling.

sa: एष नः समयो राजन् रत्नस्य सह भोजनम्। न च तं हातुमिच्छामः समयं राजसत्तम।॥
en: O king, this is our rule that we must equally enjoy a jewel that we obtain. O excellent king, we are not willing now to break that rule.

sa: देवयान्युवाच कस्माद् गृह्णासि मे वस्त्रं शिष्या भूत्वा ममासुरि। समुदाचारहीनाया न ते साधु भविष्यति॥
en: Devayani said : O daughter of the Asura, how do you dare take my cloth, being my pupil. Destitute of good conduct, nothing good can come to you.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच कथयित्वा च तत् सव ब्राह्मणेभ्यः स भारत। प्रययौ हिमवत्पार्वं ततो वज्रधरात्मजः॥
en: Vaishampayana said : O descendant of Bharata, the son of the wielder of thunder (Indra), having narrated everything to the Brahmanas, started for the side of the Himalayas.

sa: स तु लब्धा वरं वीरस्तारक्षसुतो हरिः॥ ससृजे तत्र वापी तां मृतानां जीविनीं प्रभो।
en: O lord, after having obtained the boon, that war-like son of Tarakaksha, named Hari, created a lake in that city, which possessed the power of reviving the dead.

sa: न त्वां समर्थाः संग्रामे पाण्डवाः सह सोमकैः। बलाद् योधयितुं वीर सत्यमेतद् ब्रवीमि ते॥
en: I will tell you truth, O hero, that the Pandavas together with the Somakas, are incapable of fighting with you, even though they put forth their (utmost energy).

sa: नैतयोस्तु समः कश्चिद् दिवि वा मानुषेषु वा। अनुगम्यास्त्रयो लोकाः सह देवर्षिचारणैः॥ सर्वदेवगणाश्चापि सर्वभूतानि यानि च। अनयोस्तु प्रभावेण वर्तते निखिलं जगत्॥
en: Either in Heaven or earth there is none to equal them; they are above all the Heavenly Rishis and Charanas of the three worlds, all the Gods and creatures come after them; they are properly speaking the main stay of the whole world.

sa: यदा बाल: सुभद्रायाः सुतः शस्त्रविना कृतः। युष्माभिनिहतो युद्धे तदा धर्मः क वो गतः॥
en: Where did this righteousness of yours fly when you ruthlessly slew in battle that child viz., Subhadra's son when he was deprived to the use of his weapons;

sa: अकरोत् सहसा नारदं पाण्डूनां भयमादधत्॥ तद् युद्धमासीत् युमहद् घोरं देवासुरोपमम्। द्रोणस्य च महाराज भीमस्य च महात्मनः॥ यदा तु विशिखैस्तीक्ष्णैर्दोणचापविनिः सृतैः।
en: Then he uttered a loud war-cry, inspiring there with the Pandavas with terror. Then a dreadful combat commenced between the highsouled Bhima and Drona, that resembled that between the Gods and Asuras. Then with the sharp shafts shot from the bow of Drona.

sa: मही वियद् दिशः सर्वाः समुद्रा गिरयोऽपि वा। स्फुटन्तीति जना जजुः पार्थस्य तलनिःस्वनात्।। १०५
en: Hearing the terrible sound of Parth's palms people thought that all the oceans, the whole earth, all the ten directions, the ethereal vault were going to burst out.

sa: तान् प्रदुतान् कुरून् दृष्ट्वा कर्णः शस्त्रभृतां वरः। संचिन्तयित्वा पार्थस्य वधे दने मनः श्वसन्॥
en: Having seen that the Kauravas have all fled from the battle-field, Karna the best of warriors, drew a deep sigh and thinking a while determined to slay Partha,

sa: योऽसौ सदा शूरमदेन मत्तो विकत्थते संसदि कौरवाणाम्। प्रियोऽत्यर्थं तस्य सुयोधनस्य कञ्चित् सपापो निहतस्त्वसाध॥
en: Have you, indeed, slain that favourite of Suyodhana who, being elated with the pride of chivalry, ever used to indulge in selfglorification amidst the assembly of the Kurus?

sa: वासुदेव उवाच पुराव्याधोऽभवत् कश्चिद् बलाको नाम भारत। यात्रार्थ पुत्रदारस्य मृगान् हन्ति न कामतः॥
en: Vasudeva said There was once a hunter, O Bharata, Balaka by name. He used to kill animals, not willfully but, in order to support his children and wife.

sa: राजा दुःशासनश्चैव कृपः शारद्वतस्तथा॥ अश्वत्थामा कृतवर्मा शकुनिश्च महाबलः। न्यहनन् पाण्डवीं सेनां शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः॥
en: And the king (Duryodhana), killed the Pandava forces by hundreds and thousands as did also Dushasana, Kripa, the son of Sharadvata, Ashvatthama, Kritavarman and Shakuni of great strength.

sa: न जानीघे प्रतिज्ञां मे विप्रोत्पत्तिं तथैव च॥ द्रोणं हत्वा किल मया हन्तव्यस्त्वं सुदुर्मते।
en: O Brahmana, you are neither aware of my promise nor of my of my origin. Of wicked understanding as you are, I will slay you after killing Drona.

sa: उपवासकृशो राजा भृशं भरतसत्तमः। ब्राह्मे बले स्थितो ह्येष न क्षात्रे हि बले विभुः॥
en: O foremost of Bharatas, the king is great emaciated with fasts. He is gifted with the force of a Brahmana, but he is not endued with Kshatriya prowess.

sa: न दिशो द्यौर्न चोर्वी च न समं विषमं तथा। हस्तसंस्पर्शमापन्नान् परानप्यथवा स्वकान्॥ न्यपातयंस्तदा युद्धे नराः स्म विजयैषिणः। उद्भूतत्वात् तु रजसः प्रसेकाच्छोणितस्य च॥ प्राशाम्यत रजो भौमं शीघ्रत्वादनिलस्य च। तत्र नागा हया योधा रथिनोऽथ पदातयः॥
en: Nor the quarters of heaven, nor the welkin, nor the earth, nor the undulations of land. The warriors, impelled by the thought of victory, slew friends and foes indiscriminately, in fact all whom they perceived by their touch. The dust that had arisen was very soon driven away by the winds that began to blow then and it wad quenched by the blood that shed profusely. Elephants, steeds, car-warriors and foot-soldiers.

sa: संजय उवाच यस्त्वं शोचसि कौरव्य वर्तमाने महाभये। त्वमस्य जगतो मूलं विनाशस्य न संशयः॥
en: Sanjaya said O descendant of the Kuru dynasty, why are you now lamenting for the present carnage? Surely you are the root of this destruction of the worlds.

sa: कल्पतां मे रथो भूयो युज्यन्तां च हयोत्तमाः। आयुधानि च सर्वाणि सज्जन्तां मे महारथे।॥
en: Let my chariot be again got ready and let the best of steeds be harnessed thereto and let all sorts of arms be placed in that superb vehicle.

sa: मम बाहुं रणे राजन् दक्षिणं युद्धदुर्मदम्॥ न चात्मा रक्षितव्यो वै राजन् रणगतेन हि।
en: Why should I not protect "Satyaki who is, O king, like my own right arm to me? In battle, one should not look after his own protection only.

sa: न चास्य रक्षां पश्यामि पार्श्वतो न च पृष्ठतः। एक एवाभियाति त्वां पश्य साफल्यमात्मनः॥
en: He is advancing all alone, there is none to guard him in the front or in the rear and well may you now count upon success following you.

sa: यो हि यन्मनसा कामं दध्यौ त्रिपुरसंश्रयः॥ तस्मै कामं मयस्तं त विदधे मायया तदा।
en: Thenceforth whoever amongst those dwelling in those cities entertained whatever wish in his heart it was then Maya who fulfilled their desires by aid of his illusory energy.

sa: इदं च दृष्टं जगता सहं त्वया कृतं यदेकेन किरीटमालिना। यथा न कुर्याद् बलभिन्न चान्तको न चापि धाता भगवान् न यक्षराट्॥
en: It will be hard for the slayer of Bala (Indra) or Yama or Prachetas or the famous king of Yakshas to perform the heroic feats that have been done by crown-headed Arjuna single handed. You yourself and the whole world have seen that.

sa: तस्मात् पर्णानि शाखाश्च स्कन्धं चोत्सृज्य सूतज। कृष्णं हि विद्धि पाण्डूनां मूलं सर्वत्र सर्वदा॥
en: Therefore, O son of Suta, leave alone the leaves, the branches and the trunk of the Pandava tree. Know Krishna to be its root, ever and every where.

sa: अज्ञानाद्धि क्षिपन् बाणान् घोररूपान् भयानकान्। होमधेन्वा वत्समस्य प्रमत्त इषुणाहनम्॥ चरन्तं विजने शल्य ततोऽनुव्याजहार माम्। यस्मात् त्वया प्रमत्तेन होमधेन्वा हतः सुतः॥
en: O king, while wandering about to set arrows my Vijaya bow I myself unconsciously killed with an arrows the calf of a Brahmana's Homa I began discharging dreadful shafts while it was roaming in the dense forest. The Brahmana then addressed me, saying-

sa: रक्ष्यमाणश्च बलिभिश्छादयामास सात्यकिम्। तं छाद्यमानं विशिखैर्दृष्ट्वा संनतपर्वभिः॥
en: Supported by those heroes, (Somadatta) covered Satyaki with arrows. Seeing him covered with straight arrows,

sa: ततो दशसहस्राणि गजानां भीमकर्मणाम्॥ जधान गदया भीमस्तस्य राज्ञः परिच्छदम्। ततोऽन्येभिहता नागा रथाश्च शतशो बलात्॥
en: Ten thousand powerful elephants, forming the king's retinue, were then struck down by Bhimasena with his mace. Later on hundreds of other elephants and charioteer fell through Bhima's powerful hands.

sa: तां छित्वा समरे कर्णस्त्रिभिारत सायकैः। शिखण्डिनमथाविध्यन्नवभिर्निशितैः शरैः॥
en: Cutting it off in battle with three arrows Karna struck Shikhandi with nine sharp arrows.

sa: पञ्चभिः पञ्चभिर्बाणैः पुनर्विव्याध सात्यकिः। ततः स रथिनां श्रेष्ठस्तव पुत्रस्य सारथिम्॥ आजघानाशु भल्लेन स हतो न्यपतद् भुवि। पतिते सारथौ तस्मिंस्तव पुत्ररथः प्रभो॥
en: Were pierced each with five arrows by Satyaki. Then that foremost of warriors struck the driver of your son with a broad-headed shaft. The latter then fell down on the ground slain. When his charioteer had been laid low, O master, that car-warrior, your son.

sa: ततः पुनः षोडशभिर्नतपर्वभिराशुगैः॥ सात्यकिः कृतवर्माणं प्रत्यविध्यत् स्तनान्तरे।
en: Then again Satyaki pierced Kritavarman on the breast, with sixteen swift-flying arrows of depressed knots.

sa: परिस्तोमैः कुथाभिश्च परिघैरङ्कुशैस्तथा। शक्तिभिर्भिन्दिपालैश्च तूणैः शूलैः परश्वधैः॥
en: With elephants' trappings, Kudhas, Parighas and Ankushas, maces and Brindipalas, arrow-cases, spiked maces and Parasvadhas.

sa: एतच्छुत्वापि राधेयो दुर्योधनवचो महान्। मद्रराजमिदं वाक्यमब्रवीत प्रहसन्निव॥
en: Hearing those weighty words of Duryodhana, Karna, as if smiling, said to the Madra king.

sa: संजय उवाच श्रिया कुलेन यशसा तपसा च श्रुतेन च। त्वामद्य सन्तो मन्यन्ते ययातिमिव नाहुषम्॥
en: Sanjaya said The sages consider you to be equal to Yayati, the son of Nahusha, in beauty, in lineage, in celebrity, in austerity and in the knowledge about the Shastras.

sa: तस्मिन कृते भीमसेनेन रूपे दृष्ट्वा जनाः शोणितं पीयमानम्। सम्प्राद्रवंश्चित्रसेनेन सार्ध भीमं रक्षो भाषमाणा भयार्ताः॥
en: He became so horrible to look at when drinking the blood that your troops with Chitrasena becoming afraid took to their heels saying that he is surely a Rakshasa. (Monster).

sa: द्रोणस्य च महाराज संजयानां च सर्वशः। तमसा चावृते लोके न प्राज्ञायत किंचन॥ सैन्येन रजसा चैव समन्तादुत्थितेन ह। नरस्याश्वस्य नागस्य समसजत शोणितम्॥
en: Of great king, between Drona (on one hand) and all the Srinjayas (on the other). In consequence of the night being enveloped in darkness and of the dust raised by the soldiers nothing could be discerned. The blood of men, horses and elephant mingled together.

sa: संजय उवाच तत्राकरोद् दुष्करं राजपुत्रो दुःशासनस्तुमुलं युद्धयमानः। चिच्छेद भीमस्य धनुः शरेण षष्ट्या शरैः सारथिमप्यविध्यत्॥
en: Sanjaya said In that fight Prince Dushasana fought with great prowess and performed difficult feats; with a single arrows he severed Bhimasena's bow and struck his driver with six others.

sa: रथान् ससूतान् सहयान् गजांश्च सर्वानरीन् मृत्युवशं शरौघैः। निन्ये हयांश्चैव तथा ससादीन् पदातिसङ्घांश्च तथैव पार्थः॥
en: Partha thus inflicting the enemy with a heavy downpour of shafts rent them asunder with all their cavalry and elephant soldiers, as also the rides and riders of their war-chariots.

sa: ते हेमपुलैरिषुभिरर्दिता हेममालिनः। हताः पेतुर्महानागाः साग्निज्वाला इराद्रयः॥
en: Those mighty elephants adorned with golden necklaces, being distressed by goldwinged arrows, fell down dead.

sa: व्याकुलीकृत्य तं द्रोणो बृहत्क्षत्रं महारथम्। अश्वांश्चतुर्भिर्व्यवधीच्चतुरोऽस्य पतत्रिभिः॥
en: Then confounding that mighty car-warrior Vrihatkshatra, Drona slew his four steeds with four winged shafts.

sa: कच्चिद् राजा धृतराष्ट्रः सपुत्रो वैचित्रवीर्यः कुशली महात्मा। महाराजो बाह्निकः प्रातिपेयः कच्चिद् विद्वान् कुशली सूतपुत्र॥
en: Is the large-minded king Dhritarashtra, the son of Vichitravirya, well along with his sons. Is the great king Balhika, the son of Pratipa, O you learned son of Suta (caste).

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच योगं मे परमं तात मोक्षस्य वद भारत। तमहं तत्त्वतो ज्ञातुमिच्छामि वदतां वर॥
en: Yudhishthira said Tell me, O sire, that high Yoga by which, O Bharata, I may obtain liberation. O foremost of speakers, I wish to know everything about that Yoga truly.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच प्रतिगृहणामि ते वाचमिमां सत्यां जनार्दन॥
en: Yudhishthira said : O Janardana, I accept these words of your to be true. son

sa: भीष्म उवाच वृद्धानां ब्रुवतां तात श्रुतं मे यत् पुरातनम्। वक्ष्यामि तदशेषेण रोहिण्यो निर्मिता यथा।॥
en: Bhishma said I have, O son, heard old men recite this history about the circumstances under which the Kapila cow was created. I shall recite that old history to you.

sa: यथावद्वेदविद्वांसः सर्वे बुद्धेः परंगताः। ऋद्ध्या परमया युक्तमिष्टं द्विजगणैर्युतम्॥ प्रभूतधनधान्याढ्यमृत्विग्भिः सुनिषेवितम्। निर्माय चापि विधिवद्यज्ञायतनमीप्सितम्॥ राजानं दीक्षयामासुः सर्पसत्राप्तये तदा। इदं चासीस्त्रार्वं सर्पसत्रे भविष्यति॥
en: It was graced by the presence of holy Brahmanas; it was decked with much valuable wealth; it was full of wealth and paddy. On this sacrificial platform they according to rites installed the king in the Snake-sacrifice. But before the commencement of the sacrifice happened.

sa: स गृहं धृतराष्ट्रस्य प्राविशच्छत्रुकर्शनः। पाण्डुरं पुण्डरीकाक्षः प्रासादैरुपशोभितम्॥
en: That lotus-eyed grinder of foes entered the gray-coloured abode of Dhritarashtra graced with many palaces.

sa: हतानभिमुखान् वीरान् वीरैः शतसहस्रशः॥ आरोप्यारोप्य गच्छन्ति विमानेष्वप्सरोगणाः।
en: Having placed on their cars thousands of heroes slain in battle the Apsara went on.

sa: स एष जनको राजा दुर्वृत्तमपि चेत् सुतम्। दण्ड्यं दण्डे निक्षिपति तथा न ग्लाति धार्मिकम्।२९॥
en: Janaka is such a king that, even if his son be a cruel and a criminal one, he puts him under punishment. But he never inflicts penalty upon the virtuous.

sa: कुरुभियुध्यते सार्ध सर्वेश्चक्रगदाधरः। आह कुन्ती नूनमार्या पापमद्य निदर्शनम्॥ द्रौपदी च सुभद्रा च पश्यन्त्यौ सह बन्धुभिः। स भीम त्वरया युक्तो याहि यत्र धनंजयः॥
en: The wilder of the mace and the discus battling with the Kurus! Surely numero auspicious omnens are today being seen by mic nerable Kunti and Drupadi and Subhadra and 1 their friends. Therefore, O Bhima, at the top your speed, proceed to the spot where hananjaya is.

sa: यस्य स्म विषये राज्ञः स्तेनो भवति वै द्विजः। राज्ञ एवापराधं तं मन्यन्ते किल्बिषं नृप॥
en: That king, O monarch, in whose dominion a Brahmana becomes a thief, is considered to be the doer of that misdeed. The king is visited by sins on that account.

sa: शोणितव्यतिषिक्तायां वसुधायां च भूमिप। तद्रजस्तुमुलं घोरं क्षणेनान्तरधीयत॥
en: The earth being drenched with blood, O king, that thick and dreadful dust soon disappeared.

sa: यस्य यस्य तु यः कामस्तस्मिन् काले बभूव ह। तं तं विसृष्टवान् व्यासो वरदो धर्मवत्सलः॥
en: Devoted to the duties of piety, Vyasa, at that time, becoming a giver of boons, granted to all the men there collected the fruition of the desires they respectively cherished.

sa: इन्द्रगोपकचित्रं च यदेतच्चारुदर्शनम्। राज्ञो युधिष्ठिरस्यैतद् वैराटे धनुरुत्तमम्॥
en: the other most excellent and beautiful bow, variegated with insects, belongs to the king Yudhishthira.

sa: विष्णुरुवाच न ते महि भयं कार्यं भारार्ते वसुधारिणि। अहमेवं तथा कुर्मि यथा लघ्वी भविष्यसि॥
en: Vishnu said: O Earth, O holder of treasures, O burdened earth, do not be afraid; I shall act in the way by which you will be relieved of your burden.

sa: लोमश उवाच यत् तेऽहं परिपृष्टोऽस्मि कथामेतां युधिष्ठिर। तत् सर्वमखिलेनेह श्रूयतां मम भाषतः॥ पुरा कृतयुगे तात वर्तमाने भयंकरे। यमत्वं कारयामास आदिदेवः पुरातनः॥
en: Lomasha said: O Yudhishthira, hear all in detail as I narrate the story which you have asked me to relate. O child, in the days of yore, in a terrible time in the Treta Yuga the ancient and primeval deity performed the duties of Yama.

sa: ततः सुदर्शनं नागं नीलजीमूतसंनिभम्। ऐरावतकुले जातमारुरोह महोदरः॥
en: Then Mahodara mounted the elephant Sudarsana-sprung in the race of Airāvata, and resembling dark-blue clouds.

sa: रावणस्य हयान्रामो हयान्रामस्य रावणः। जघ्नतुस्तौ तदान्योन्यं कृतानुकृतकारिणौ॥
en: They opposing each other, Rāvana slew Rāma's steeds and Rāma in his turn slew Rāvana's.

sa: विभीषणश्च रक्षोभिश्चतुर्भिः परिवारितः। उपासते महात्मानं धनेशमिव गुह्यकः॥
en: As the Guhyakas worship Kubera so Vibhiş aņa, accompanied by four Rākşasas, waited upon him.

sa: स तस्य वाक्यं प्रतिपूर्णघोषं ज्याशब्दमुग्रं च निशम्य राजा। आसाद्य सौमित्रिमुपस्थितं तं रोषान्वितं वाचमुवाच रक्षः॥
en: Hearing Saumitri's speech uttered in a full voice, as well as the terrific twangs of his bowstring, that Raksasa-the king-approaching Sumitrā son staying in the field, spoke to him wrathfully.

sa: इत्युक्त्वा सप्तभिर्बाणैरभिविव्याध लक्ष्मणम्। दशभिस्तु हनूमन्तं तीक्ष्णधारैः शरात्तमैः॥
en: Seeing this, he pierced Lakşmaņa with seven shafts, and Hanumān with ten keen-edged excellent shafts.

sa: दीपिकाः काञ्चनीः काश्चिज्जगृहुस्तत्र योषितः। वालव्यजनहस्ताश्च तालवृन्तानि चापराः॥
en: There among those fair ones, some carried torches with gold handles, chowries and some fans.

sa: समुत्पतितमेघस्य वीचिमालाकुलस्य च। विशेषो न द्वयोरासीत्सागरस्याम्बरस्य च॥
en: They sky enveloped with clouds and the ocean overflowing with surges presented no contrast whatsoever.

sa: पूर्वद्वारं तु कुमुदः कोटिभिर्दशभिर्वृतः। आवृत्य बलवांस्तस्थौ हरिभिर्जितकाशिभिः॥
en: The strong Kumuda, surrounded by ten kotis of victorious monkeys, stood obstruction the Estern gate.

sa: ततः सहस्रनयनः प्रीतियुक्तः शुभाननः। कुशेशयमयीं मालामुत्क्षिप्येदं वचोऽब्रवीत्॥
en: Thereupon the thousand eyed, charming Indra setting aside the garland of lotus flowers spoke thus.

sa: ततोऽङ्गदं परिक्षिप्तं विभिनैर्ऋतपुङ्गवैः॥ हनूमानथ विज्ञाय नीलश्चापि प्रतस्थतुः।
en: Seeing Angada assailed by the three redoubtable Rakşasas, Hanumān and Nila proceeded (to his rescue).

sa: तरसा पूर्यमाणोऽपि तदा वानरपुङ्गवः। आश्रमेषु महर्षिणामपराध्यति निर्भयः॥
en: Having become powerful, the best of Mongoloids, started committing offences against Maharsis in their hermitages.

sa: तस्य चैव शिरो नास्ति न बाहू जानुनी न च। न धनुर्न रथो नाश्वास्तत्रादृश्यन्त नेषवः॥
en: And (non) there was neither seen there his head, nor his arms, nor his thighs, nor his bow, nor his car, nor his steeds, nor his arrows at that place.

sa: ततस्तमभिदुद्राव सगदो हैहयाधिपः। भ्रामयाणो गदां गुर्वी पञ्चबाहुशतोच्छ्याम्॥
en: Thereupon uplifting the huge club, five hundred hands long, the king of Haihayas pursued Prahasta.

sa: ततस्तु वारनामात्यास्तारस्तारापिता प्रभुः। उवाच वानरो वाक्यं युद्धप्रेप्सुमुपागतम्॥
en: Thereat, Tara, her father Susena and the Prince Sugrīva said to the king of Rākşasas.

sa: वारयन्तो भृशं प्राप्ताः पाला जानुभिराहताः। तथा न गणितश्चायं कपिर्दधिमुखो बली॥ पतिर्मम वनस्यायमस्माभिः स्थापितः स्वयम्। दृष्टा देवी न संदेहो न चान्येन हनूमता ॥
en: For this the warders were struck on their kneejoints for obstructing their revelry and for this they went so far as to disregard the powerful monkey Dadhimukha. I myself appointed this monkey the lord of my orchard. Forsooth has Hanumān espied the worshipful Sītā and none else.

sa: विमृज्य वदनं तस्य कपिराजस्य धीमतः। अब्रवीत्कालसंप्राप्तमसंभ्रान्तमिदं वचः॥
en: And washing the face of the intelligent monkey-monarch, Vibhisana spoke these words, seasonable and sedate.

sa: ततः परमतेजस्वी अङ्गदः प्लवगर्षभः। उत्पाट्य वृक्षं स्थितवानासीत्पुष्पफलैर्युतः॥
en: Then the exceedingly energetic Angada-best of-monkeys-uprooting a tree, stood there, covered with flowers and leaves.

sa: ते रथान्तरचरा एके दृप्तानेके दृढान्हयान्। नागानेकेऽधिरुरुहुर्जग्मुश्चैके पदातयः॥
en: Then some set out, mounting cars, and some mounting proud coursers, and some on foot.

sa: स विद्युजिह्वेन सहैव तच्छिरो धनुश्च भूमौ विनिकीर्यमाणः। विदेहराजस्य सुतां यशस्विनी ततोऽब्रवीत्तां भव मे वशानुगा॥
en: When Vidyujjibha placed the head of that man, Ravana poured the bow on earth. Then he spoke to illustrious Sītā, the daughter of king Videha to submit to his desire.

sa: एवमुक्त्वा तु तान्सरािक्षसान्परिपश्यतः। यूथपानपि तान्सांस्ताडयत्स च रावणिः॥ नीलं नवभिराहत्य मैन्दं सद्विविदं तथा। त्रिभिस्त्रिभिरमित्रघ्नस्तताप परमेषुभिः॥
en: Saying this in the presence of all the Raksasas, Ravana's son-destroyer of foesfencing the monkey-leaders, hit Nila with nine arrows, and hurt Mainda and Dvivida each with three powerful shafts.

sa: ततो मे बुद्धिरुत्पन्ना श्रुत्वा तामद्भुतां गिरम्॥ अदग्धा जानकीत्येव निमित्तैश्चोपलक्षितम्। दीप्यमाने तु लाङ्गुले न मां दहति पावकः॥ हृदयं च प्रहृष्टं मे वाताः सुरभिगन्धिनः।
en: Hearing those wonderful words I regained my sense. I was then convinced by an auspicious sign that Jänaki was not burnt down, for I was not reduced to ashes albeit my tail was burning. My heart was excited with joy and the wind spread its delicious fragrance.

sa: तस्यैवं वचनं श्रुत्वा धर्मराजः प्रतापवान्। अब्रवीत्तत्र तं मृत्युं त्वं तिष्ठेनं निहन्म्यहम्॥ ततः संरक्तनयनः क्रुद्धो वैवस्वतः प्रभुः। कालदण्डममोघं तु तोलयामास पाणिना॥ यस्य पार्श्वेषु निहिताः कालपाशाः प्रतिष्ठिताः। पावकाशनिसंकाशो मुद्गरो मूर्तिमान्स्थितः॥
en: Hearing these words of his, the puissant king of righteousness spoke there to death, 'Do you stay. I myself shall slay him.' Then with his eyes reddened that lord, Vaivasvata, wielded with his hand the infallible dart of time; while by him lay the redoubtable noose of time and the mace in its native shape resembling fire and the thunderbolt.

sa: अथ राक्षससिंहस्य कृष्णान्कनकभूषणान्। शरैश्चतुर्भिः सौमित्रिर्विव्याध चतुरो हयान्॥
en: Then Sumitrā's son pierced the four black steeds of the leonine Räksasa, caparisoned in gold.

sa: अवेक्षमाणस्तु तदा ददर्श कपिकुञ्जरः। रूपयौवनसम्पन्ना रावणस्य वरस्त्रियः॥ ताभिः परिवृतो राजा सुरूपाभिर्महायशाः। तन्मृगद्विजसंघुष्टं प्रविष्टः प्रमदावनम्॥
en: Beholding him, that foremost of monkeys saw that highly famous king Rāvana, surrounded by his excellently beautiful and youthful wives, enter that forest of enjoyment filled with birds and animals.

sa: वानराश्च महावीर्या विंशतिः कामरूपिणः। सुग्रीवप्रमुखा राममुपासन्ते महौजसः॥
en: The twenty heroic monkeys headed by the highly powerful Sugrīva also began to worship him.

sa: उपतस्थुमहात्मानो मन्त्रिणः सपुरोहिताः। वसिष्ठप्रमुखाः सर्वे दीप्यमाना इवाग्नयः॥
en: There arrived the leading priests headed by Vaşistha and ministers all resplendent like to fire.

sa: ततः प्रमाथी रभसः शरभो गन्धमादनः। अमृष्यमाणाश्चत्वारश्चनुर्वेगं हरीश्वराः॥
en: Then those monkey-chiefs— Pramāthi, Rabhasa, Sarabha and Gandamādana, not brooking (their foe) summoned their impetuosity.

sa: रथं तस्य समासाद्य बाहुमुद्यम्य दक्षिणम्। त्रासयनरावणं धीमान्हनूमान्वाक्यमब्रवीत्॥
en: Coming at his car, the intelligent Hanumān, uplifting his right arm and terrifying Rāvana, said.

sa: ततोवाच प्रहस्यैतान्रावणः क्रोधमूर्च्छितः। महोदरमहापार्टी विरूपाक्षं च राक्षसम्॥
en: Thereupon Ravana, beside himself with anger, laughing, addressed those Raksasas, Mahodara, Mahāpārsva, and Virūpākşa, saying.

sa: एवमुक्तो महाबाहुर्माणिभद्रः सुदुर्जयः। वृतो यक्षसहस्रेस्तु चतुर्भिः समयोधयत्॥
en: Thus addressed, the mighty-armed and invincible Mānibhadra, surrounded by four thousand Yakşas began the fight.

sa: अपध्वंसत नश्यध्वं संनिकर्षादितो मम। नहि वां हन्तुमिच्छामि स्मराम्युपकृतानि वाम्। हतावेव कृतघ्नौ द्वौ मयि स्नेहपराङ्मुखौ॥
en: Avaunt! Go hence from near me! I do not wish to slay you, remembering your good acts. Slain you (already) are, who are ingrate and cherish no affection for me.

sa: देवगन्धर्वकन्याश्च नागकन्याश्च तास्ततः। परिवार्य दशग्रीवं प्रविशुस्ता गृहोत्तमम्॥
en: And encircling Rāvana those daughters of celestials Gandharvas and Nāgas, entered into an excellent abode.

sa: इहैवाशुभकर्माणः कर्मभिर्निरयं गताः। अवाग्गतिरियं कष्टा यत्र पच्यन्ति मानवाः। तस्मात् सुदुर्लभो मोक्षो रक्ष्यश्चात्मा ततो भृशम्॥
en: On account of their own decds, creatures acquirc even here superior or inferiors enjoyments. Doers of evil deeds here, on ! account of those deeds of theirs, attain to hell.

sa: तिष्ठेद् युगसहस्रं तु पदेनैकेन यः पुमान्। मासमेकं तु गङ्गाया समौ स्यातां न वा समौ॥
en: It cannot be said whether one who stands for a thousand years on one foot and one who lives for only a month by the side of Ganga are equal.

sa: भीष्म उवाच अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम्। ऋषेरुद्दालकेर्वाक्यं नाचिकेतस्य चोभयोः॥
en: Bhishma said Regarding it is cited the old discourse between the Rishi Uddalaki and Nachiketa.

sa: अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम्। गौतमस्य मुनेस्तात संवादं वासवस्य च॥
en: Regarding it is cited the old discourse, O son, between the ascetic Gautama and Vasava.

sa: अग्निरुवाच ब्रूत यद् भवतां कार्यं कर्तास्मि तदहं सुराः। भवतां तु नियोज्योऽस्मि मा वोऽत्रास्तु विचारणा।।५०
en: Agni said Tell me what your business is. I shall, O gods accomplish it. I am always willing to do anything for you. Do not, hesitate, therefore, to command me.

sa: अर्जुन उवाच को न्वसौ ब्राह्मणः कृष्ण कश्च शिष्योजनार्दन। श्रोतव्यं चेन्मयैतद् वै तत्त्वमाचक्ष्व मे विभो॥
en: Arjuna said Who, indeed, was was that Brahmana, O Krishna, and who the pupil, O Janardana! Truly, if am worthy of hearing it, do you then tell me, O Lord!

sa: इति भ्रातृवचः श्रुत्वा न हन्मि त्वां नराधिप। उत्तिष्ठ न भयं तेऽस्ति स्वस्तिमान् गच्छ पार्थिव॥२४
en: Having heard these commands of my brother, I shall not kill you, O king! Rise up; let no fear be yours; return to your city safe and sound, O king.

sa: व्यास उवाच गावः प्रतिष्ठा भूतानां तथा गावः परायणम्। गाव: पुण्याः पवित्राश्च गोधनं पावनं तथा॥
en: Vyasa said Kine form the support of all creatures. Kine are the refuge of all creatures. Kine are the embodiment of virtue. Kine are sacred, and kine purifiers of all.

sa: श्री उवाच लोककान्तास्मि भद्रं वः श्री माहं परिश्रुता। मया दैत्याः परित्यक्ता विनष्टाः शाश्वतीः समाः॥६
en: Shree said Blessed be you, I am dear to all creatures. Indeed. I am known by the name of Shree. Forsaken by me, the demons have been lost for ever.

sa: यदि वै स्त्री न रोचेत पुमांसं न प्रमोदयेत्। अप्रमोदात् पुनः पुंसः प्रजनो न प्रवर्धते॥
en: If the wife does not like her husband or fails to please him, from such dislike and absence of joy, the husband can never have children for increasing his family.

sa: अस्मिन् हि बहवः साधो ये ममासन् मनोरथाः। ते द्रोणपुत्रेण हताः किं नु जीवामि केशव॥
en: In him, Orighteous one, I placed many expectations! Alas, when these have been frustrated by Drona's son, what necessity have I, O Keshava, to carry on the burden of life?

sa: वासुदेव उवाच अहं गुरुर्महाबाहो मनः शिष्यं च विद्धि मे। त्वत्प्रीत्या गुह्यमेतच्च कथितं ते धनंजय॥
en: I am the preceptor, O mighty armed one, and know that the inind is my pupil. Through my affection for you. O Dhananjaya, I have described this mystery to you.

sa: यः साधनार्थं काष्ठानि ब्राह्मणेभ्यः प्रयच्छति। प्रतापनार्थं राजेन्द्र वृत्तवद्भ्यः सदा नरः॥ सिद्ध्यन्त्यर्थाः सदा तस्य कार्याणि विविधानि च। उपर्युपरि शत्रूणां वपुषा दीप्यते च सः॥
en: That man who makes presents, to Brahmanas having the means of life, of firewood for purposes of coO king as also for enabling them to drive cold, finds all his purposes and all his acts successful. Such a one is seen to shine over all his enemies.

sa: गौतम उवाच यत्र प्रेत: यत्र प्रेतो नन्दति पुण्यकर्मा शोचते पापकर्मा। स्तत्र त्वाहं हस्तिनं यातयिष्ये॥
en: Gautama said O illustrious king, going even to that region of Yama where the pious live happily and the sinful in grief, I shall take from you this my elephants.

sa: स त्वं राजन् स्थिरो भूत्वा रणे कृत्वा दृढां मतिम्। योधयस्व रणे पार्थान् स्वर्गं परायणम्॥
en: Therefore, O king, with all your patience, and forming a firm resolution for battle, do you fight with the sons of Pritha, loO king upon paradise as your final goal.

sa: एवमन्ये महेष्वासा ब्राह्मणैः क्षत्रिया भुवि। जाता: परमधर्मज्ञां वीर्यवन्तो महाबलाः। एतच्छ्रुत्वा त्वमप्यत्र मात: कुरु यथेप्सितम्॥
en: It was thus that many virtuous, greatly energetic and exceedingly strong bow-men, Kshatriyas, were born from the Brahmanas. Hearing this, O mother, do as you like in this matter. Q

sa: सर्प उवाच निर्दोषं दोषवन्तं वा न त्वां मृत्यो ब्रवीम्यहम्। त्वयाहं चोदित इति ब्रवीम्येतावदेव तु॥
en: The serpent said I do not, O Mrityu, blame you, nor do I set you free from all blame. I only say that I am directed and influenced by you.

sa: एवमुक्तस्तथेत्युक्त्वा काकुत्स्थः सहलक्ष्मणः। प्रदक्षिणं मुनिं कृत्वा प्रस्थातुमुपचक्रमे॥
en: Thus addressed, Kākutstha along with Laks maņa, having gone round the ascetic, prepared for departing.

sa: स तान् कृताञ्जलिर्भूत्वा परिपप्रच्छ वै वसुः॥ कस्य वै को मतः कामो ब्रूत सत्यं द्विजोत्तमाः।
en: Thus accosted by them, Vasu joined his hands in humility and said to them,-Tell me truly, ye foremost of Brahmanas, what opinion is held by you individually in this matter?

sa: षोडश स्त्रीसहस्राणि वासुदेवपरिग्रहः। अमज्जंस्ताः सरस्वत्यां कालेन जनमेजय॥
en: Sixteen thousand women had been the time came, O Janamejaya, they plunged into the Sarasvati.

sa: वाग्भिर्मनोऽनुकूलाभिः पूजयन्तो जनाधिप। जम्बूद्वीपात् प्रवर्तन्ते रत्नानि विविधान्युत॥
en: With gratifying words and respectful adoration. o king, various gems from Jambudvipa are used there.

sa: सर्वाणामधिपतिधूम्रो नामैष यूथपः॥ यवीयानस्य तु भ्राता पश्यैनं पर्वतोपमम्। भ्रात्रा समानो रूपेण विशिष्टश्च पराक्रमे॥ स एष जाम्बवानाम महायूथपयूथपः। प्रशान्तो गुरुवर्ती च संप्रहारेष्वमर्षणः॥
en: Behold this one resembling a hill-younger brother of Dhūmra, lord of all the bears. He is equal to this brother in beauty, and of superior prowess. This leader of redoubtable leaders is named Jämbavān. He is mild, obedient to his superiors and fierce in fight.

sa: न सम्बुबुधिरे चैनं देवास्तं भुवनेश्वरम्॥ सप्रजापतयः सर्वे बालार्कसदृशप्रभम्। अथाभ्येत्य ततो ब्रह्मा दृष्ट्वा स च महेश्वरम्॥ अयं श्रेष्ठ इति ज्ञात्वा ववन्दे तं पितामहः।
en: O gods, you could not recognise that lord of the worlds. Thereafter the celestials with the Prajapati approached that boy of the radiance of the rising Sun. Then Brahma behclding the mighty lord and the grandsire knowing him to be the paramount master, began to adore him

sa: विष्णुरुवाच प्रीतस्तेऽहमलौल्येन भक्त्या तव च सत्तम॥ अवश्यं हि त्वया ब्रह्मन् मत्तो चाह्यो वरो द्विज।
en: Vishnu said, "O excellent one. I am pleased with your this littleness of desire and great devotion. O Brahmana, O twice-born one, you should certainly accept some boon from me."

sa: मातुल: शकुनिः शल्यः कृपो द्रोणो विविंशतिः। यत्ता रक्षन्तु गाङ्गेय तस्मिन् गुप्ते ध्रुवो जयः॥ ।
en: Our maternal uncle Shakuni, Shalya, Kripa, Drona, and Vivingshati, should protect, putting forth their best energies, the son of Ganga. If he is duly protected, victory indubitably will be ours."

sa: आश्वासयंस्तं महात्मा तदानीं गच्छन्नूचं रोदसी व्याप्य लक्ष्म्या॥
en: The high-souled one comforted him and then ascended upwards, filling the entire sky with splendour.

sa: तस्मात् सान्त्वं सदा वाच्यं न वाच्यं परुषं क्वचित्। पूज्यान् सम्पूजयेद् दद्यान्न च याचेत् कदाचन॥
en: Therefore, you should always utter sweet words that give pleasure and not pain. You should always give and never beg. You should show respects to those that deserve your respect.

sa: नारुन्तुदः स्यान्न नृशंसवादी न हीनतः परमभ्याददीत्। ययास्य वाचा पर उद्विजेत न तां वदेदुषती पापलोक्याम्॥
en: You should never give pain to others by cruel words. Never defeat your enemies by despicable means. Never utter such sinful and burning words as may give pain to others.

sa: आदित्यकेतुर्बह्वाशी कुण्डधारो महोदरः। अपराजितः पण्डितको विशालाक्षः सुदुर्जयः॥
en: Adityaketu, Bahvashin, Kundadhara, Mahodara, Aparajita, Panditaka, and Vishalaksha, all difficult of being conquered in battle,

sa: एतदाख्याय रामाय महर्षिः कुम्भसंभवः। अस्यामेवापरं वाक्यं कथायामुपचक्रमे॥
en: Having related this story to Rāma the great saint Agastya again said in this context.

sa: यत्र मे तनया: जीयन्ते न जयनत्युत। यत्र भीष्मस्य द्रोणस्य कृपस्य च महात्मनः॥ सौमदत्तेश्च वीरस्य भगदत्तस्य चोभयोः। अश्वत्थाम्नस्तथा तात शूराणामनिवर्तिनाम्॥ अन्येषां चैव शूराणां मध्यगास्तनया मम। यदहन्यन्त संग्रामे किमन्यद् भागधेयतः॥
en: In as much as, my sons are never victorious and are ever vanquished in battle, in as much as my sons remaining amidst, Drona, Bhishma, the illustrious Kripa, and the heroic son of Somadatta, and Bhagadatta, and O son, Ashvathama, and many other heroic and valiant warriors of high-soul, still slaughtered in battle, what can it be but (adverse) Fate?

sa: शिततीक्ष्णाग्रधाराणि समुद्यम्य सुरोत्तमाः। सविस्फुलिङ्गज्वालानि सधूमानि च सर्वशः॥
en: All emitting fire with smoke and all raised up by the best of the celestials.

sa: अथैवमुक्तः शार्दूलो रावणेनोत्तमश्चरः। इदं वचनमारेभे वक्तुं रावणसंनिधौ॥
en: Thus addressed by Rāvana, Sārdula—best of spies-thus began to speak in the presence of Ravana.

sa: तद् दृष्ट्वा वीडितो राजन् स मुनिः पादयोर्गतः। नान्यद् देवात् परं मेने रुद्रात् परतरं महत्॥
en: O king, seeing this the Rishi became filled with shame and fell at his feet. Believing that there was nothing better and greater than the Rudra, (he thus adored him).

sa: द्वाःस्थस्त्वागम्य रामाय सर्वानेव कृताञ्जलिः॥ निवेदयामास तथा भ्रातृन्स्वान्समुपस्थितान्।
en: Thereupon returning, the warder, with folded। hands, communicated to Rama, the arrivals of his brothers.

sa: या हि वैश्रवणे लक्ष्मीर्या चन्द्रे हरिवाहने। सा रावणगृहे रम्या नित्यमेवानपायिनी॥ या च राज्ञः कुबेरस्य यमस्य वरुणस्य च। तादृशी तद्विशिष्टा वा ऋद्धी रक्षोगृहेष्विह॥
en: The same enchanting splendour that is in Vaiśravaņa or the ray-riding Moon, remained ever constant and abiding in, Rāvana's abode. And the prosperity of king Kubera, or Yama, or Varuna, was here present in the house of the Rākşas, or even surpassed by the prosperity (of Rāvana).

sa: स्वभावः कर्म च शुभं यत्र शूद्रेऽपि तिष्ठति। विशिष्टः स द्विजाते विज्ञेय इति मे मतिः॥
en: When a pious nature and pious deeds are seen in even a Shudra, he should, according to my opinion, be held supcrior to a person of the three twiceborn classes.

sa: एवमुक्तस्तदा सम्यग्बृहस्पतिरुदारधीः। कामात्मानं तदात्मानं न शशाक नियच्छितुम्॥
en: Having been thus addressed by her, Brihaspati, though greatly intelligent, could not suppress his desire.

sa: पुरस्योपनिविष्टस्य सहसा पीडितस्य ह। नान्ययुद्धात्प्रपश्यामि मोक्षं युद्धविशारदाः॥
en: "Save battle, deliverance find I none for the city suddenly beleaguered and put to straits.

sa: यथास्वं चाहकाण्येषां शब्दादीनामिमानि तु। इन्द्रियाणि यदा देही धारयन्निव तप्यते॥ लोके विततमात्मानं लोकं चात्मनि पश्यति। परावरज्ञो यः शक्तः स तु भूतानि पश्यति॥
en: When a person engages in Tapa after having duly subdued his senses which have their own proper objective play in the external conditions of sound, form, then he sees that his own spirit pervades the whole universe and the universe is also reflected in him.

sa: तथा माल्यवतः शृङ्गे पूर्वपूर्वानुगण्डिका॥ योजनानां सहस्राणि पञ्चषण्माल्यवानथ।
en: o summit of the Malyavat, small mountains. O king, the Malyavat measures eleven thousand Yojanas.

sa: श्रूयतां राम शक्रस्य कथां कथयतः श्रुताम्। अस्मिन् देशे हि यद् वृत्तं शृणु तत्त्वेन राघव॥
en: Do you listen, O Rāma to what I had heard from Sakra relating this history; and, O descendant of Raghu, do you listen to all that befell in this city.

sa: यदा तु गुणजालं तत् प्राकृतं वै जुगुप्सते। पश्यते च परं पश्यं तदा पश्यन्न संत्यजेत्॥
en: Indeed, when Individual Soul shows no affection for Nature and her principles, he then succeeds in seeing the Supreme and having once seen Him wishes not to lose that happiness.

sa: अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम्। ब्रह्मणा सह संवादं त्र्यम्बकस्य विशाम्पते॥
en: Regarding it is cited the old discourse between Brahman, O king, and the Three-eyed Mahadeva.

sa: ततस्तं मणिभद्रस्तु पुनर्वचनमब्रवीत्। देवानामेव वचनात् कुण्डधारं महाद्युतिम्॥
en: Hearing this, Manibhadra, ordered by the gods, once more said to the highly intelligent Kundadhara.

sa: न भूतानामहिंसाया ज्यायान् धर्मोऽस्ति कश्चन। यस्मानोद्विजते भूतं जातु किंचित् कथंचन। सोऽभयं सर्वभूतेभ्यः सम्प्राप्नोति महामुने॥
en: There is no duty superior to the duty of not injuring other creatures. He whom, 0 great ascetic, no creature fears in the least, does not himself fear any creatures.

sa: व्यास उवाच यथा वै विहिता वृत्तिः पुर ताद् ब्रह्मणा स्वयम्। एषा पूर्वतरैः सद्भिराचीर्णा परमर्षिभिः॥
en: The course of conduct that was fist laid down by Brahman himself was duly followed by the wise and pious persons of yore viz., the great Rishis of ancient times.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच कथं व्यासस्य धर्मात्मा शुको जज्ञे महातपाः। सिद्धिं च परमां प्राप्तस्तन्मे ब्रूहि पितामह॥
en: Yudhishthira said Tell me, O grandfather, how the great Shuka of austere penances took birth as the son of Vyasa, and how did he succeed in acquiring the highest success?
